ex.en: A key issue for higher education in the 1990s is the need for greater diversity of courses.
ex.zh: 20世纪90年代高等教育的一个关键问题是需要使课程更加多样化。

e.en: If something is the issue, it is the thing you consider to be the most important part of a situation or discussion.

ex.en: I was earning a lot of money, but that was not the issue.
ex.zh: 我是挣着很多钱，但那不是问题的关键。

ex.en: Do not draw it on the chart, however, as this will confuse the issue.
ex.zh: 但是不要把它画在图表上，因为这将使要点模糊不清。

e.en: An issue of something such as a magazine or newspaper is the version of it that is published, for example, in a particular month or on a particular day. (杂志或报刊的)

ex.en: The growing problem is underlined in the latest issue of the Scientific American.
ex.zh: 这一日益严重的问题在最新一期的《科学美国人》上得到强调。

e.en: If you issue a statement or a warning, you make it known formally or publicly. 发表 (声明); 发出 (警告)

ex.en: Last night he issued a statement denying the allegations.
ex.zh: 昨天晚上，他发表了一项声明否认那些说法。

ex.en: The government issued a warning that the strikers should end their action or face dismissal.
ex.zh: 该政府发出了警告，罢工者们应停止他们的行动，否则将被免职。

d: n. 议题，争论点；（报纸、杂志等的）期，号；发放，分配；（新股票或邮票等的）发行；子女，后嗣；流出，发出；结果，后果
v. 发表，颁布；分发，分配；正式发行；流出，发出；由……产生，由……得出

e.en: If you say that someone is a liar, you mean that they tell lies.

ex.en: He was a liar and a cheat.
ex.zh: 他是一个说谎的人，一个骗子。

d: n. 骗子，说谎者
【名】 （Liar）（美、俄、德）莉娅尔（人名）

e.en: If an activity, organization, or product is lawful, it is allowed by law.

ex.en: The detention of the fugitive was lawful.
ex.zh: 对逃亡者的拘留是合法的。

e.en: 合法地

ex.en: Amnesty International is trying to establish whether the police acted lawfully in shooting him.
ex.zh: 大赦国际正试图证实警察向他开枪是否合法。

d: adj. 合法的，法律许可的；法定的
n. 卡罗尔（女子名，等于 Carol）

e.en: If one person joins another, they move or go to the same place, for example, so that both of them can do something together.

ex.en: His wife and children moved to join him in their new home.
ex.zh: 他的妻子和孩子们搬来和他一起住在新家。

e.en: If you join an organization, you become a member of it or start work as an employee of it. 参加 (组织)

ex.en: He joined the Army five years ago.
ex.zh: 他５年前参了军。

e.en: If you join an activity that other people are doing, you take part in it or become involved with it. 参加 (活动)

ex.en: The United States joined the war in April 1917.
ex.zh: 美国于1917年4月参战。

ex.en: The pastor requested the women present to join him in prayer.
ex.zh: 该牧师请在场的妇女和他一起祈祷。

e.en: If you join a line, you stand at the end of it so that you are part of it. 加入 (队列)

ex.en: It is advised that fans seeking autographs join the line before practice starts.
ex.zh: 建议寻求亲笔签名的影迷们在活动开始前排好队。

d: n. 连接；接缝；连接物
v. 连接，接合；参加，加入；入伍，参军；和（某人）一起（做某事）；到（某人）处（会合）；联合；汇合；上（飞机、火车）；上（路）；加入（行列）（join 的现在分词）

e.en: A factory is a large building where machines are used to make large quantities of goods.

ex.en: He owned furniture factories in New York State.
ex.zh: 他在纽约州拥有一些家具厂。

d: n.  工厂，制造厂；（在外国的）代理店

e.en: A garment is a piece of clothing; used especially in contexts where you are talking about the manufacture or sale of clothes. 衣服 (尤用于衣服生产和销售的领域)

ex.en: Many of the garments have the customers' name tags sewn into the linings.
ex.zh: 这些衣服中很多都把顾客的姓名牌缝进衬里中。

d: n. 衣服，服装，衣着（garment 的复数）

e.en: A brand of a product is the version of it that is made by one particular manufacturer.

ex.en: Winston is a brand of cigarette.
ex.zh: 云斯顿是一种香烟品牌。

ex.en: I bought one of the leading brands.
ex.zh: 我买了知名品牌中的一种。

e.en: A brand of something such as a way of thinking or behaving is a particular kind of it. (思维或行为方式等的)

ex.en: Joel Hatch brings his own unique brand of humour to the role.
ex.zh: 乔尔·哈奇把他自己独具一格的幽默带进了这个角色。

e.en: If someone is branded as something bad, people think they are that thing. 归为 (不好的事物)

ex.en: I was instantly branded as a rebel.
ex.zh: 我立刻被归为造反者。

ex.en: The company has been branded racist by some of its own staff.
ex.zh: 这家公司被它自己的一些职员归为种族主义者。

e.en: When you brand an animal, you put a permanent mark on its skin in order to show who it belongs to, usually by burning a mark onto its skin.

ex.en: The owner couldn't be bothered to brand the cattle.
ex.zh: 主人懒得给这牛打上烙印。

d: n. 品牌；烙印；类型，种类（均为 brand 的复数）；（Brands）人名（德语译作布兰茨、英语译作布兰兹）
v. 给…打上烙印；加商标于；铭刻于（brand 的第三人称单数）；把…归为，贬称为（常与 as 连用）

e.en: A brand of a product is the version of it that is made by one particular manufacturer.

ex.en: Winston is a brand of cigarette.
ex.zh: 云斯顿是一种香烟品牌。

ex.en: I bought one of the leading brands.
ex.zh: 我买了知名品牌中的一种。

e.en: A brand of something such as a way of thinking or behaving is a particular kind of it. (思维或行为方式等的)

ex.en: Joel Hatch brings his own unique brand of humour to the role.
ex.zh: 乔尔·哈奇把他自己独具一格的幽默带进了这个角色。

e.en: If someone is branded as something bad, people think they are that thing. 归为 (不好的事物)

ex.en: I was instantly branded as a rebel.
ex.zh: 我立刻被归为造反者。

ex.en: The company has been branded racist by some of its own staff.
ex.zh: 这家公司被它自己的一些职员归为种族主义者。

e.en: When you brand an animal, you put a permanent mark on its skin in order to show who it belongs to, usually by burning a mark onto its skin.

ex.en: The owner couldn't be bothered to brand the cattle.
ex.zh: 主人懒得给这牛打上烙印。

d: n. 品牌，商标；（独特的）一种，一类；（动物身上标明所属的）烙印，火印；独特的个性，自成一格的形象；燃烧的木头，烧焦的木头；（打印用的）烙铁；火炬，剑
v. 打烙印于（牲畜，以标明所属）；给……冠以恶名，谴责；给……设计品牌，加商标于；铭刻，铭记
【名】 （Brand）（英、美、德、瑞）布兰德（人名）

e.en: Clothing is the things that people wear.

ex.en: Some locals offered food and clothing to the refugees.
ex.zh: 一些当地人向难民提供食物和衣服。

ex.en: ...the clothing industry.
ex.zh: …服装业。

d: n. 衣服，（尤指某种）服装
v. 给……穿衣，为……提供衣服，赋予（某人某品质）（clothe 的现在分词）
n. 斯梅德利（姓氏）

e.en: Cotton is a type of cloth made from soft fibres from a particular plant.

ex.en: ...a cotton shirt.
ex.zh: …一件棉布衬衫。

e.en: Cotton is a plant which is grown in warm countries and which produces soft fibres used in making cotton cloth.

ex.en: ...a large cotton plantation in Tennessee.
ex.zh: …位于田纳西州的一个大棉花种植园。

e.en: Cotton or absorbent cotton is a soft mass of cotton, used especially for applying liquids or creams to your skin. 脱脂棉;
Cotton is thread that is used for sewing, especially thread that is made from cotton.

d: n. 棉，棉花；棉布；棉线，棉纱；脱脂棉，药棉
adj. 棉的，棉制的
v. 开始领会，开始明白；喜爱，喜欢
【名】 （Cotton）（英、西、葡）科顿，（法）戈登（人名）

e.en: To manufacture something means to make it in a factory, usually in large quantities.

ex.en: They manufacture the class of plastics known as thermoplastic materials.
ex.zh: 他们生产被称为热塑材料的塑料类制品。

ex.en: The first three models are being manufactured at the factory in Dayton.
ex.zh: 最初的3个型号正在代顿的工厂生产。

e.en: Manufacture is also a noun.

ex.en: ...the manufacture of nuclear weapons.
ex.zh: …核武器的生产。

e.en: 生产

ex.en: ...management headquarters for manufacturing in China.
ex.zh: …设在中国的生产管理总部。

e.en: In economics, manufactures are goods or products which have been made in a factory.

ex.en: ...a long-term rise in the share of manufactures in non-oil exports.
ex.zh: …非石油出口产品中工业品份额的长期增长。

d: n. 制造，制造业
v. （用机器）大量生产，成批制造；编造，捏造；生成，产生（一种物质）（manufacture 的现在分词）

e.en: You can refer to a boat, a spacecraft, or an aircraft as a craft. 船; 航天器;

ex.en: With great difficulty, the fisherman manoeuvred his small craft close to the reef.
ex.zh: 渔夫艰难地驾着小船靠近了礁石。

e.en: A craft is an activity such as weaving, carving, or pottery that involves making things skilfully with your hands.

ex.en: ...the arts and crafts of the North American Indians.
ex.zh: …北美印第安人的美术工艺。

e.en: You can use craft to refer to any activity or job that involves doing something skilfully.

ex.en: ...the craft of writing.
ex.zh: …写作工作。

e.en: If something is crafted, it is made skilfully.

ex.en: The windows would probably have been crafted in the latter part of the Middle Ages.
ex.zh: 这些窗户可能是中世纪后期精制而成。

ex.en: ...original, hand-crafted bags at affordable prices.
ex.zh: …价格适中的独创手工包。

d: n. 工艺，手艺；船，艇，飞行器；诡计，骗术；行业，职业；手工艺品
v. 精心制作
【名】 （Craft）（英、德、罗）克拉夫特（人名）

e.en: If something attracts people or animals, it has features that cause them to come to it.

ex.en: The Cardiff Bay project is attracting many visitors.
ex.zh: 加的夫湾工程吸引着众多的参观者。

e.en: If someone or something attracts you, they have particular qualities which cause you to like or admire them. If a particular quality attracts you to a person or thing, it is the reason why you like them.

ex.en: He wasn't sure he'd got it right, although the theory attracted him by its logic.
ex.zh: 他不能确定自己理解是否正确，尽管该理论的逻辑推理引起了他的兴趣。

e.en: If you are attracted to someone, you are interested in them sexually. (性的)

ex.en: In spite of her hostility, she was attracted to him.
ex.zh: 尽管心存敌意，她还是被他吸引住了。

e.en: 被吸引的

ex.en: He was nice looking, but I wasn't deeply attracted to him.
ex.zh: 他长得挺好看，但我并没有被他深深吸引。

d: v. 吸引；（物体间）产生引力；引起；有吸引力

e.en: Founding means relating to the starting of a particular institution or organization.

ex.en: The committee held its founding congress in the capital, Riga.
ex.zh: 委员会在首都里加举行了成立大会。

d: n. （组织、公司、学校等的）创建，创办
adj. 创办的，建立的
v. 创办，成立；建造，兴建；根据，以……为基础（found 的现在分词形式）

e.en: a glossy durable black lacquer originally from the Orient, used on wood, metal, etc
relating to or varnished with japan
to lacquer with japan or any similar varnish

d: n. 日本（Japan）；日本漆；日本漆器
v. 为……上黑亮漆

e.en: Long means a great amount of time or for a great amount of time.

ex.en: Repairs to the cable did not take too long.
ex.zh: 维修电缆没花太长时间。

ex.en: Have you known her parents long?
ex.zh: 你认识她的父母很久了吗？

e.en: The expression for long is used to mean "for a great amount of time."

ex.en: "Did you live there?"—"Not for long."
ex.zh: “你以前住在那里吗？”—“没住多久。”

e.en: A long event or period of time lasts for a great amount of time or takes a great amount of time.

ex.en: We had a long meeting with the attorney general.
ex.zh: 我们和首席检察官开了一个长会。

ex.en: She is planning a long holiday in Europe.
ex.zh: 她正打算去欧洲度一次长假。

e.en: You use long to ask or talk about amounts of time.

ex.en: How long have you lived around here?
ex.zh: 你在这附近住多久了？

ex.en: He has been on a diet for as long as any of his friends can remember.
ex.zh: 从他的朋友能记得时开始，他就一直在节食。

d: adj. 长的；长久的，长期的；漫长的；长篇的；长音的；出界的；（面部表情）不高兴的，愁苦的；记得牢的，记得久的；（可能性，机会）小的，渺茫的；远期（获利）的；（酒与凉饮料）混合的，大量的；（运动中的球）长传的，远距离的
adv. 长久地，长期地；很久（以前或以后）；整个（时间段）；（球扔得）远；整个 (时间段)
v. 渴望
n. 长时间，长时期；长音；远期证券；长期资本

e.en: Knitting is something, such as an article of clothing, that is being knitted.

ex.en: She had been sitting with her knitting at her fourth-floor window.
ex.zh: 她一直坐在5楼的窗户旁做编织活。

e.en: Knitting is the action or process of knitting.

ex.en: Take up a relaxing hobby, such as knitting.
ex.zh: 从事一种让人放松的业余爱好，比如编织。

d: n. 编织，针织；编织物，针织品；[外科]骨愈合
v. 编织，针织；结合；皱眉（knit 的 ing 形式）

e.en: Luxury is very great comfort, especially among beautiful and expensive surroundings.

ex.en: By all accounts he leads a life of considerable luxury.
ex.zh: 从方方面面来讲，他都过着极为奢侈的生活。

e.en: A luxury is something expensive which is not necessary but which gives you pleasure.

ex.en: A week by the sea is a luxury they can no longer afford.
ex.zh: 去海边一周成了一种奢侈，他们再也负担不起。

e.en: A luxury item is something expensive which is not necessary but which gives you pleasure. 奢侈的 (物品)

ex.en: He could not afford luxury food on his pay.
ex.zh: 凭他的薪水，他吃不起奢侈的食品。

e.en: A luxury is a pleasure which you do not often have the opportunity to enjoy.

ex.en: Hot baths are my favourite luxury.
ex.zh: 热水浴是我钟爱而难得的享受。

d: n. 奢华，华贵；奢侈品；不常有的乐趣，难得的享受
adj. 奢侈的，豪华的

e.en: A machine is a piece of equipment that uses electricity or an engine in order to do a particular kind of work.

ex.en: I put the coin in the machine and pulled the lever.
ex.zh: 我把硬币投进机器，然后拉了控制杆。

e.en: You can use machine to refer to a large and well-controlled system or organization.

ex.en: ...Nazi Germany's military machine.
ex.zh: …纳粹德国的军事机构。

e.en: If you machine something, you make it or work on it using a machine. 用机器制造;

ex.en: The material is machined in a factory.
ex.zh: 该材料在一家工厂用机器加工而成。

ex.en: ...machined brass zinc alloy gears.
ex.zh: …机器加工的黄铜锌合金齿轮。

d: n. 机器，机械（machine 的复数）
v. 用机器制造或加工（machine 的第三人称单数形式）

e.en: You use own to indicate that something belongs to a particular person or thing.

ex.en: My wife decided I should have my own shop.
ex.zh: 我妻子决定我应该有自己的店铺。

ex.en: He could no longer trust his own judgement.
ex.zh: 他再也不相信自己的判断了。

e.en: Own is also a pronoun.

ex.en: He saw the major's face a few inches from his own.
ex.zh: 他看到少校的脸离他自己的脸只有几英寸。

e.en: You use own to indicate that something is used by, or is characteristic of, only one person, thing, or group.

ex.en: Jennifer insisted on her own room.
ex.zh: 詹尼弗坚持要自己专用的房间。

ex.en: Each nation has its own peculiarities when it comes to doing business.
ex.zh: 说到做生意，每个民族都有它自己独有的一些特性。

e.en: Own is also a pronoun.

ex.en: This young lady has a sense of style that is very much her own.
ex.zh: 这位年轻女士具有一种她自己独有的时尚观。

d: v. 拥有；承认；彻底击败（own 的过去式和过去分词）
adj. 被拥有的；有所有者的；自身拥有的（常用于 state-owned、privately owned 等复合形容词）

e.en: A pair of things are two things of the same size and shape that are used together or are both part of something, for example, shoes, earrings, or parts of the body. 双;

ex.en: ...a pair of socks.
ex.zh: …一双袜子

ex.en: ...earrings that cost $142.50 a pair.
ex.zh: …价值$142.50一对的耳环。

e.en: Some objects that have two main parts of the same size and shape are referred to as a pair, for example, a pair of trousers or a pair of scissors. 副; 条 (裤子)

ex.en: ...a pair of faded jeans.
ex.zh: …一条退色的牛仔裤。

e.en: You can refer to two people as a pair when they are standing or walking together or when they have some kind of relationship with each other. (站或走在一起的) 两人; (有某种关系的)

ex.en: A pair of teenage boys were smoking cigarettes.
ex.zh: 两个青少年正在抽烟。

ex.en: The pair admitted that their three-year-old marriage was going through "a difficult time."
ex.zh: 那对夫妇承认他们3年的婚姻正在经历一个困难时期。

e.en: If one thing is paired with another, it is put with it or considered with it.

ex.en: The trainees will then be paired with experienced managers.
ex.zh: 这些实习生之后将被配给有经验的经理们。

d: n. （成双的两物品）一对，一双；（由两个相连的类似部分组成的）一套，一副；两个共事（或有特殊关系）的人；（成对物的）另一只，（搭档的）另一人；（交配的）一对动物；两匹并排驾车的马；对子（指两张同点的纸牌）；（议会中）相约放弃投票权的敌对两党的两名议员（或其中一名）
v. 使成对，配对；（使）结成一对（恋人）（pair off/up）；（动物）交配（=pair up）；使（敌对两党的两名议员）组成不投票的一对
【名】 （Pair）佩尔（姓氏）

e.en: Polo is a game played between two teams of players. The players ride horses and use wooden hammers with long handles to hit a ball.

d: n. 马球（骑在马上用长柄木槌击球的团队运动）；水球（多用于 water polo）；Polo衫（polo shirt）；polo neck：高圆翻领，高领套头衫；（Polo）人名，尤指意大利旅行家马可·波罗，法、俄、西、意、芬、阿尔巴译作“波洛”

e.en: Scissors are a small cutting tool with two sharp blades that are screwed together. You use scissors for cutting things such as paper and cloth.

ex.en: He told me to get some scissors.
ex.zh: 他叫我去拿几把剪刀。

d: n. 剪刀；（英橄）交叉配合，交叉移动；（跳高）剪式跳法
v. 用剪刀剪；使（腿）作剪式运动（scissor 的第三人称单数形式）

e.en: A shirt is a piece of clothing that you wear on the upper part of your body. Shirts have a collar, sleeves, and buttons down the front.

d: n. 衬衫，恤衫；球衣；运动队队员

e.en: A site is a piece of ground that is used for a particular purpose or where a particular thing happens. 场地;

ex.en: I was working as a foreman on a building site.
ex.zh: 我在一个建筑工地当工头。

e.en: The site of an important event is the place where it happened. (事件发生的) 现场;

ex.en: Scientists have described the Aral sea as the site of the worst ecological disaster on earth.
ex.zh: 科学家们把咸海描绘成地球上生态环境最差的地方。

e.en: A site is a piece of ground where something such as a statue or building stands or used to stand. 地点; 遗址;

ex.en: ...the site of Moses' tomb.
ex.zh: …摩西墓遗址。

e.en: A site is the same as a .

d: n. （建筑的）工地，用地；（某事发生的）地点，现场；（作某种用途的）场所，场地；网站，站点（=website）；（身体的某个）部位；（城镇、建筑物或纪念碑的）地基，选址；遗址，原址；（帐篷或大篷车内）歇脚的地方
v. 使坐落在，为......选址

e.en: Someone who is skilled has the knowledge and ability to do something well. 有技术的;

ex.en: Few doctors are actually trained, and not all are skilled, in helping their patients make choices.
ex.zh: 在帮助病人做选择方面，没有几个医生实际受过训练，也并非所有的医生都很熟练。

e.en: Skilled work can only be done by people who have had some training. 需要熟练能力的;

ex.en: New industries demanded skilled labour not available locally.
ex.zh: 新兴产业需要熟练技术工人，而当地没有。

d: adj. 熟练的，有技能的；技术性的，需要熟练技术的

e.en: A skill is a type of work or activity which requires special training and knowledge. (专门)

ex.en: Most of us will know someone who is always learning new skills, or studying new fields.
ex.zh: 我们大多数人都会认识一些总在学习新技术或研究新领域的人。

e.en: Skill is the knowledge and ability that enables you to do something well. 技能;

ex.en: The cut of a diamond depends on the skill of its craftsman.
ex.zh: 切割钻石的好坏取决于工匠的技艺。

d: n. （特定的）技术，技能，技巧（skill 的复数）
n. 蒂娜（女子名）

e.en: If something is true, it is based on facts rather than being invented or imagined, and is accurate and reliable.

ex.en: Everything I had heard about him was true.
ex.zh: 我所听到的关于他的一切都是真的。

ex.en: He said it was true that a collision had happened.
ex.zh: 他说碰撞真的发生了一次。

e.en: You use true to emphasize that a person or thing is sincere or genuine, often in contrast to something that is pretended or hidden. (人或物品)

ex.en: I allowed myself to acknowledge my true feelings.
ex.zh: 我愿意承认自己的真实感情。

e.en: If you use true to describe something or someone, you approve of them because they have all the characteristics or qualities that such a person or thing typically has.

ex.en: This country professes to be a true democracy.
ex.zh: 该国宣称自己是一个真正的民主国家。

ex.en: Maybe one day you'll find true love.
ex.zh: 也许有一天你会找到真爱。

e.en: If you say that a fact is true of a particular person or situation, you mean that it is valid or relevant for them. 确实的;

ex.en: I accept that the romance may have gone out of the marriage, but surely this is true of many couples.
ex.zh: 我承认浪漫可能已从婚姻中消失，但许多夫妻的确都是如此。

d: adj. 真实的；正确的
adv. 真实地；准确地
n. 真实；准确
vt. 装准

e.en: If you adapt to a new situation or adapt yourself to it, you change your ideas or behaviour in order to deal with it successfully.

ex.en: The world will be different, and we will have to be prepared to adapt to the change.
ex.zh: 这个世界将会不同，所以我们必须准备好适应变化。

e.en: If you adapt something, you change it to make it suitable for a new purpose or situation.

ex.en: Shelves were built to adapt the library for use as an office.
ex.zh: 做了个书架，以便将这个图书馆改作一个办公室用。

d: v. 适应；调整，使适合，改造，改装；改编（adapt 的现在分词/动名词）

e.en: If you go somewhere via a particular place, you go through that place on the way to your destination.

ex.en: We drove via Lovech to the old Danube town of Ruse.
ex.zh: 我们驱车经由洛维奇去了多瑙河畔的古城鲁塞。

e.en: If you do something via a particular means or person, you do it by making use of that means or person.

ex.en: The technology to allow relief workers to contact the outside world via satellite already exists.
ex.zh: 允许救援人员通过卫星与外界取得联系的技术已经存在。

d: prep. 经由，经过（某一地方）；通过，借助于（某种手段或人）

e.en: An age-old story, tradition, or problem has existed for many generations or centuries. (故事、传统、问题等)

ex.en: This age-old struggle for control had led to untold bloody wars.
ex.zh: 这种由来已久的对控制权的争夺已经导致了无数的血腥战争。

d: adj. 古老的，由来已久的

e.en: Accommodation is buildings or rooms where people live or stay.

ex.en: The government will provide temporary accommodation for up to three thousand homeless people.
ex.zh: 政府将为多达三千无家可归的人提供临时住所。

e.en: Accommodation is space in buildings or vehicles that is available for certain things, people, or activities. (楼内或车内等)

ex.en: Their offices are housed in rented accommodation in a modernized wing of the Mathematics Institute.
ex.zh: 他们的办公室坐落在数学研究所的现代化侧楼的租赁楼层中。

d: n.  住宿，膳宿；住处，办公处，停留处；（楼房或交通工具内的）空间，座位；和解，调和；（通过改变眼球晶状体形状）自动调焦

e.en: If one thing is alongside another thing, the first thing is next to the second.

ex.en: He crossed the street and walked alongside Central Park.
ex.zh: 他过了马路，然后在中央公园旁边走着。

e.en: Alongside is also an adverb.

ex.en: He waited several minutes for a car to pull up alongside.
ex.zh: 他等了几分钟等一辆车停靠在旁边。

e.en: If you work alongside other people, you all work together in the same place. 与…并肩 (工作)

ex.en: He had worked alongside Frank and Mark and they had become friends.
ex.zh: 他曾与弗兰克和马克并肩工作过，他们已经成为朋友了。

d: prep. 在……旁边；沿着……的边；与……一起，与……并肩（工作）；与……相比；与……同等重要的；同时，共存
adv. 在旁边

e.en: Your age is the number of years that you have lived. (人的)

ex.en: She has a nephew who is just ten years of age.
ex.zh: 她有个才满10岁的侄子。

ex.en: At the age of sixteen he qualified for a place at the University of North Carolina.
ex.zh: 16岁时他取得了北卡罗来纳大学的入学资格。

e.en: The age of a thing is the number of years since it was made. (物的)

ex.en: Everything in the room looks in keeping with the age of the building.
ex.zh: 该房间里的一切看起来都和该楼的年代相符。

e.en: Age is the state of being old or the process of becoming older. 年长;

ex.en: Perhaps he has grown wiser with age.
ex.zh: 或许他已经随着年龄的增长变得更睿智了。

ex.en: This cologne, like wine, improves with age.
ex.zh: 这种科隆香水像葡萄酒一样越陈越香。

e.en: When someone ages, or when something ages them, they seem much older and less strong or less alert. 使显老;

ex.en: He had always looked so young, but he seemed to have aged in the last few months.
ex.zh: 他曾一直显得很年轻，但是在过去的几个月里他似乎显得老了。

d: n. 年龄，年纪；寿命，（物的）年代；法定年龄；时代，时期；年龄段；很长时间；成长，年老，陈年；（地质）代
v. 变老，老化；（使）显老，（使）苍老；（使）变陈，（使）成熟；推算年龄
【名】 （Age）（西、荷）阿赫，（瑞典）阿格，（日）扬（人名）
adj．古老的外观：指物品或建筑等看起来非常古老、历史悠久的样子。

e.en: Someone who has an apprenticeship works for a fixed period of time for a person who has a particular skill in order to learn the skill. Apprenticeship is the system of learning a skill like this. 学徒期;

ex.en: After serving his apprenticeship as a toolmaker, he became a manager.
ex.zh: 在完成了工具匠的学徒期之后，他当上了经理。

d: n. 学徒期；学徒身份；学徒制

e.en: An artisan is someone whose job requires skill with their hands.

d: n. 工匠，技工，手艺人（artisan 的复数形式）

e.en: An aspect of something is one of the parts of its character or nature.

ex.en: Climate and weather affect every aspect of our lives.
ex.zh: 气候和天气影响我们生活的每个方面。

ex.en: He was interested in all aspects of the work here.
ex.zh: 他对这里工作的各方面都感兴趣。

e.en: The aspect of a building or window is the direction in which it faces. (建筑物或窗子的)

ex.en: The house had a southwest aspect.
ex.zh: 这房子为西南朝向。

d: n. 方面，特色；朝向，方位；外表，外观；（动词的）体
v. （行星与另一天体）形成角度关系
n. 奥德丽（女子名）
n. （Beatles）披头士乐队（英国摇滚乐队, The Beatles）
n. （Beatles）（美）波娅特丽（人名）
n. 孟加拉国（南亚国家，正式全称孟加拉人民共和国）

e.en: Began is the past tense of . (begin)

d: v. 开始，着手，创建（begin 的过去式）
n. （Began）人名；贝甘

e.en: (esp of clothing or a website, computer program, etc) made to the customer's specifications (尤指服装、网站、电脑程序等)

d: adj. 定做的，定制的
v. （bespeak 的过去式）显示，展现；表明……的存在，证明；预订

e.en: A bestseller is a book of which a great number of copies has been sold.

ex.en: By mid-August the book was a bestseller.
ex.zh: 到8月中旬，这本书已经是畅销书了。

d: n. 畅销书（bestseller 的复数）

e.en: The benefit of something is the help that you get from it or the advantage that results from it. 益处;

ex.en: Each family farms individually and reaps the benefit of its labour.
ex.zh: 每个家庭独立耕作，收获各自的劳动成果。

ex.en: I'm a great believer in the benefits of this form of therapy.
ex.zh: 我对这种疗法的益处深信不疑。

e.en: If something is to your benefit or is of benefit to you, it helps you or improves your life.

ex.en: This could now work to Albania's benefit.
ex.zh: 这可能现在对阿尔巴尼亚有利。

e.en: If you benefit from something or if it benefits you, it helps you or improves your life. 有益于;

ex.en: Both sides have benefited from the talks.
ex.zh: 双方都从会谈中获益。

e.en: If you have the benefit of some information, knowledge, or equipment, you are able to use it so that you can achieve something.

ex.en: Steve didn't have the benefit of a formal college education.
ex.zh: 史蒂夫没有接受过正规大学教育的优势。

d: n. 利益，好处；福利，救济金；义演，义卖（benefit 的复数）
v. 有益于，使受益（benefit 的第三人称单数）

e.en: A bridge is a structure that is built over a railway, river, or road so that people or vehicles can cross from one side to the other.

ex.en: He walked back over the railway bridge.
ex.zh: 他从铁路桥上走了回去。

e.en: A bridge between two places is a piece of land that joins or connects them. (连接两地的)

ex.en: ...a land bridge linking Serbian territories.
ex.zh: …连接塞尔维亚领土的陆桥。

e.en: To bridge the gap between two people or things means to reduce it or get rid of it. 克服 (障碍)

ex.en: It is unlikely that the two sides will be able to bridge their differences.
ex.zh: 双方不太可能会克服彼此间的分歧。

e.en: Something that bridges the gap between two very different things has some of the qualities of each of these things. 结合 (极为不同的两者)

ex.en: ...the singer who bridged the gap between pop music and opera.
ex.zh: …结合了流行音乐和歌剧的歌手。

d: n. 桥；桥梁，纽带；船桥，舰桥；鼻梁，鼻梁架；琴马；（固定的）假牙，齿桥；（连接两地的）狭窄地带；过渡乐节，间奏；球杆的凹口支架；桥牌
v. 弥合（分歧），消除（隔阂）；兼具……的特点；在……上架桥，横跨
【名】 （Bridge）（英）布里奇（人名）

e.en: Something that is brown is the colour of earth or of wood.

ex.en: ...her deep brown eyes.
ex.zh: …她深邃的褐色眼睛。

e.en: You can describe a white-skinned person as brown when they have been sitting in the sun until their skin has become darker than usual.
Brown is used to describe grains that have not had their outer layers removed, and foods made from these grains. (谷物) 未去壳的;

ex.en: ...brown bread.
ex.zh: …全麦面包。

ex.en: ...spicy tomato sauce served over a bed of brown rice.
ex.zh: …放在一层糙米饭上的辣番茄酱。

e.en: When food browns or when you brown food, you cook it, usually for a short time on a high flame. 使呈褐色;

ex.en: Cook for ten minutes until the sugar browns.
ex.zh: 烹调10分钟直到糖变成褐色。

d: adj. 褐色的，棕色的；肤色深的，晒黑的；未去壳的，糙的
n. 褐色，棕色；褐色的东西；眼蝶，褐蝶
v. （使）变成棕色，成褐色
【名】 （Brown）（英、意、芬、捷、德、法、西、葡）布朗（人名）

e.en: A boutique is a small shop that sells fashionable clothes, shoes, or jewellery.

d: n. 时装店，精品店
【名】 （Boutique）（法）布蒂克（人名）

e.en: A boiler is a device that burns gas, oil, electricity, or coal in order to provide hot water, especially for the central heating in a building.

d: n. （动力）锅炉（boiler 的复数）
adj．英国制造的：指在英国生产、制造的产品。

e.en: A brook is a small stream.
If someone in a position of authority will brook no interference or opposition, they will not accept any interference or opposition from others.

ex.en: From childhood on, she'd had a plan of action, one that would brook no interference.
ex.zh: 从儿时起，她已有了一个行动计划，不容干预。

d: n. 小溪，小河
v. 容忍，允许（尤指不同意见或反对意见）
【名】 （Brook）（加、美、爱、英）布鲁克（人名）
n. （Camilla）（瑞典、美、丹、挪）卡米拉（人名）

e.en: A building is a structure that has a roof and walls, for example, a house or a factory.

ex.en: They were on the upper floor of the building.
ex.zh: 他们在该建筑物的上层。

d: n. （建）建筑物（building 的复数）

e.en: A celebrity is someone who is famous, especially in areas of entertainment such as movies, music, writing, or sports. (尤指娱乐界的)

ex.en: In 1944, at the age of 30, Hersey suddenly became a celebrity.
ex.zh: 1944年，30岁的赫西突然成了一位名人。

e.en: If a person or thing achieves celebrity, they become famous, especially in areas of entertainment such as movies, music, writing, or sports. (尤指娱乐界的)

ex.en: He achieved celebrity as a sports commentator.
ex.zh: 他作为一名体育评论员而享誉四方。

d: n. 名声，名望；名人，明星

e.en: A celebrity is someone who is famous, especially in areas of entertainment such as movies, music, writing, or sports. (尤指娱乐界的)

ex.en: In 1944, at the age of 30, Hersey suddenly became a celebrity.
ex.zh: 1944年，30岁的赫西突然成了一位名人。

e.en: If a person or thing achieves celebrity, they become famous, especially in areas of entertainment such as movies, music, writing, or sports. (尤指娱乐界的)

ex.en: He achieved celebrity as a sports commentator.
ex.zh: 他作为一名体育评论员而享誉四方。

d: n. 名人，名流，明星，知名人士（celebrity 的复数）

e.en: A chair is a piece of furniture for one person to sit on, with a back and four legs.

ex.en: He rose from his chair and walked to the window.
ex.zh: 他从椅子上站起来走到窗户旁。

e.en: At a university, a chair is the position or job of professor.

ex.en: He has been appointed to the chair of sociology.
ex.zh: 他受命任职社会学教授。

e.en: The person who is the chair of a committee or meeting is the person in charge of it.

ex.en: She is the chair of the Defense Advisory Committee on Women in the Military.
ex.zh: 她是军队女兵国防顾问委员会的主席。

e.en: If you chair a meeting or a committee, you are the person in charge of it. 担任 (会议、委员会)

ex.en: He was about to chair a meeting in Venice of E.U. foreign ministers.
ex.zh: 他将担任威尼斯欧盟外交部长会议的主席 。

d: v. 主持（会议、委员会等）或担任……的主席（主任）；就任要职；入座（chair 的过去式和过去分词）

e.en: Chalk is a type of soft, white rock. You can use small pieces of it for writing or drawing with.

ex.en: ...white cliffs made of chalk.
ex.zh: …白垩绝壁。

e.en: Chalk is small sticks of chalk, or a substance similar to chalk, used for writing or drawing with.

ex.en: ...somebody writing with a piece of chalk.
ex.zh: …正用粉笔写字的某人。

e.en: If you chalk something, you draw or write it using a piece of chalk. 用粉笔画;

ex.en: He chalked the message on the blackboard.
ex.zh: 他用粉笔把这条消息写在黑板上。

d: n. 白垩；粉笔；白垩地层；用粉笔划的记号
v. 用粉笔写（或画）；用粉笔做记号；用白垩粉擦（桌球杆等）；把（酒钱）记于（某人）账上；获（胜），得（分）；变成白垩状
【名】 （Chalk）（美、英、加）乔克（人名）

e.en: A club is an organization of people interested in a particular activity or subject who usually meet on a regular basis.

ex.en: ...the Young Republicans Club.
ex.zh: … 青年共和党会社。

ex.en: ...a youth club.
ex.zh: …青年会社。

e.en: A club is a place where the members of a club meet.

ex.en: I stopped in at the club for a drink.
ex.zh: 我在俱乐部喝一杯歇歇脚。

e.en: A club is a team which competes in sports competitions.

ex.en: ...the New York Yankees baseball club.
ex.zh: …纽约扬基棒球队。

e.en: A club is the same as a .

ex.en: It's a big dance hit in the clubs.
ex.zh: 在各个夜总会这可是个热门舞。

d: n. 俱乐部，社团；活动室，俱乐部大楼；职业运动俱乐部；夜总会；高尔夫球杆；击棍；（纸牌中的）梅花
v. 棒打；泡夜总会；组成俱乐部；募集；集资
【名】 （Club）（巴、印、阿）克拉布（人名）
n. 查尔斯（男子名，也用作姓氏）

e.en: When one person or group collaborates with another, they work together, especially on a book or on some research. (尤指著书或进行研究时的)

ex.en: Much later he collaborated with his son Michael on the English translation of a text on food production.
ex.zh: 后来他和儿子迈克尔合作，把一个有关食品生产的文本翻译成英语。

ex.en: He turned his country house into a place where professionals and amateurs collaborated in the making of music.
ex.zh: 他把他的乡间小屋变成了业内外人士合作制作音乐的场所。

e.en: If someone collaborates with an enemy that is occupying their country during a war, they help them.

ex.en: He was accused of having collaborated with the Communist secret police.
ex.zh: 他被指控与纳粹党的秘密警察合作。

d: v. 合作，协作（collaborate 的过去式和过去分词）；通敌（常与 with 连用）

e.en: When you collate pieces of information, you gather them all together and examine them. 整理检点 (信息)

ex.en: Roberts has spent much of his working life collating the data on which the study was based.
ex.zh: 罗伯茨花费很多工作时间来整理检点数据，以此作为该研究的基础。

e.en: If someone, or something such as a photocopier, collates pieces of paper, they put them together in the correct order. 整理 (纸张)

ex.en: They took sheets of paper off piles, collated them and put them into envelopes.
ex.zh: 他们从纸堆中拿出一沓一沓的纸，整理好并放入信封中。

d: v. （collate 的过去式和过去分词）收集、核对并汇总（不同来源的信息或文本）；按顺序整理（纸张、文件、打印件等）；对照（文本、版本等）进行校勘；检验（印张的）排列顺序；授予（牧师）有俸圣职
adj. 已按顺序整理好的，按页码顺序排列的

e.en: A collection of things is a group of similar things that you have deliberately acquired, usually over a period of time.

ex.en: Robert's collection of prints and paintings has been bought over the years.
ex.zh: 罗伯特的印刷收藏品和藏画是多年来花钱买的。

ex.en: The Art Gallery of Ontario has the world's largest collection of sculptures by Henry Moore.
ex.zh: 安大略美术馆关于亨利•摩尔的雕塑收藏品居世界之最。

e.en: A collection of stories, poems, or articles is a number of them published in one book. (作品)

ex.en: Two years ago he published a collection of short stories called "Facing The Music."
ex.zh: 两年前，他出版了一本题为《愿赌服输》的短篇小说集。

e.en: A collection of things is a group of things.

ex.en: ...a collection of modern glass office buildings.
ex.zh: …一组玻璃幕墙的现代办公楼群。

e.en: A fashion designer's new collection consists of the new clothes they have designed for the next season.

ex.en: Her spring/summer collection for this year deliberately uses both simple and rich fabrics.
ex.zh: 她今年的春／夏装系列故意使用了既简单又华贵的材质。

d: n. 收集（collection 的复数）；（常作复数）收藏品，藏品；（商业、金融或公益；常用复数）征收或募集的款项；（时装行业；常用复数）时装系列；（计算机）集合，集合物件
adv. 连续不断地

e.en: You can refer to a boat, a spacecraft, or an aircraft as a craft. 船; 航天器;

ex.en: With great difficulty, the fisherman manoeuvred his small craft close to the reef.
ex.zh: 渔夫艰难地驾着小船靠近了礁石。

e.en: A craft is an activity such as weaving, carving, or pottery that involves making things skilfully with your hands.

ex.en: ...the arts and crafts of the North American Indians.
ex.zh: …北美印第安人的美术工艺。

e.en: You can use craft to refer to any activity or job that involves doing something skilfully.

ex.en: ...the craft of writing.
ex.zh: …写作工作。

e.en: If something is crafted, it is made skilfully.

ex.en: The windows would probably have been crafted in the latter part of the Middle Ages.
ex.zh: 这些窗户可能是中世纪后期精制而成。

ex.en: ...original, hand-crafted bags at affordable prices.
ex.zh: …价格适中的独创手工包。

d: v. 精心制作，手工制作（craft 的现在分词）
n. 手工制作；手工艺

e.en: A contract is a legal agreement, usually between two companies or between an employer and employee, which involves doing work for a stated sum of money.

ex.en: The company won a hefty contract for work on Chicago's tallest building.
ex.zh: 公司赢得了芝加哥最高建筑的重要施工合同。

ex.en: Have you read the contract?
ex.zh: 你看过这份合同了吗？

e.en: If you contract with someone to do something, you legally agree to do it for them or for them to do it for you. (与某人)

ex.en: You can contract with us to deliver your cargo.
ex.zh: 你们可以和我们签订合同，由我们负责运输你们的货物。

e.en: When something contracts or when something contracts it, it becomes smaller or shorter. 缩小; 缩短; 使缩小;

ex.en: Blood is only expelled from the heart when it contracts.
ex.zh: 心脏收缩时，血液才从心脏射出。

e.en: 收缩

ex.en: ...the contraction and expansion of blood vessels.
ex.zh: …血管的收缩与扩张。

d: n. 合同，契约；暗杀协议；（桥牌）定约墩数；婚约，订婚
v. （使）收缩，缩小；签合同，订立契约；患上，感染；订立婚约（或盟约）；欠负（债）

e.en: To create something means to cause it to happen or exist. 创造;

ex.en: We set business free to create more jobs.
ex.zh: 我们让企业自由以创造更多的就业机会。

ex.en: She could create a fight out of anything.
ex.zh: 她可以为了任何事制造争斗。

e.en: 创造

ex.en: These businesses stimulate the creation of local jobs.
ex.zh: 这些企业刺激了当地就业机会的产生。

e.en: When someone creates a new product or process, they invent it or design it. 创造;

ex.en: It is really great for a radio producer to create a show like this.
ex.zh: 一个电台节目制作人能设计出这样的节目真是太了不起了。

d: v. 创造；建立；造成（create 的过去式和过去分词）
n. 达克斯（英国品牌名）

e.en: A date is a specific time that can be named, for example, a particular day or a particular year.

ex.en: What's the date today?
ex.zh: 今天是几号？

e.en: A date is an appointment to meet someone or go out with them, especially someone with whom you are having, or may soon have, a romantic relationship.

ex.en: I have a date with Bob.
ex.zh: 我和鲍勃有个约会。

e.en: If you are dating someone, you go out with them regularly because you are having, or may soon have, a romantic relationship with them. You can also say that two people are dating. (恋爱中)

ex.en: For a year I dated a woman who was a research assistant.
ex.zh: 有一年的时间，我一直和一个女助理研究员约会。

e.en: If you have a date with someone with whom you are having, or may soon have, a romantic relationship, you can refer to that person as your date. (恋爱中的)

ex.en: He lied to Essie, saying his date was one of the girls in the show.
ex.zh: 他对埃西撒谎说他约会的对象是参加演出的女孩儿其中的一个。

d: n. （date 的复数）日期，年代；约会；约会对象；椰枣，海枣，枣子
v. （date 的第三人称单数）给……定日期，注明日期，写上日期；推断……的年代，确定……的日期；与……约会，恋爱；始于，追溯到（常与 from 或 back to 连用）；过时，不再流行
n. 德比郡（英国英格兰中部的郡）
n. 扩散，传播

e.en: When someone designs a garment, building, machine, or other object, they plan it and make a detailed drawing of it from which it can be built or made.

ex.en: They wanted to design a machine that was both attractive and practical.
ex.zh: 他们想设计一台既美观又实用的机器。

e.en: When someone designs a survey, policy, or system, they plan and prepare it, and decide on all the details of it.

ex.en: We may be able to design a course to suit your particular needs.
ex.zh: 我们也许能策划一个课程来满足你的特定需求。

e.en: Design is the process and art of planning and making detailed drawings of something.

ex.en: He was a born mechanic with a flair for design.
ex.zh: 他天生是个有设计才华的机械师。

e.en: The design of something is the way in which it has been planned and made.

ex.en: ...a new design of clock.
ex.zh: …一种新款时钟。

d: n. 设计，布局，安排；设计艺术，构思；设计图，图纸，图案（design 的复数）；意图，打算，图谋（常用复数）
v. 设计，制图，构思；筹划，制订（design 的第三人称单数）

e.en: Someone's descendants are the people in later generations who are related to them.

ex.en: They are descendants of the original English and Scottish settlers.
ex.zh: 他们是最初的英格兰和苏格兰移民的后裔。

e.en: Something modern which developed from an older thing can be called a descendant of it.

ex.en: His design was a descendant of a 1956 device.
ex.zh: 他的设计是1956年一个装置的衍生物。

d: n. 后裔，子孙；派生物，衍生物
adj. 下降的；祖传的

e.en: When an organization or person diversifies into other things, or diversifies their product line, they increase the variety of things that they do or make.

ex.en: The company's troubles started only when it diversified into new products.
ex.zh: 该公司的麻烦从实现产品多样化时才开始。

ex.en: As demand has increased, so manufacturers have been encouraged to diversify and improve quality.
ex.zh: 制造商们受需求增加的刺激而扩大生产品种，提高产品质量。

e.en: 多样化

ex.en: The seminar was to discuss diversification of agriculture.
ex.zh: 该研讨会讨论的是农业多种经营。

d: adj. 多样化的，各种的，多元化的
v. 使多样化，使变化（diversify 的过去式和过去分词）

e.en: If you dye something such as hair or cloth, you change its colour by soaking it in a special liquid.

ex.en: The women prepared, spun, and dyed the wool.
ex.zh: 妇女们将羊毛预备、纺线并染色。

e.en: Dye is a substance made from plants or chemicals which is mixed into a liquid and used to change the colour of something such as cloth or hair.

ex.en: ...bottles of hair dye.
ex.zh: …一瓶瓶的染发剂。

d: n. 染料，染色（dye 的复数形式）；（Dyes）人名；（德）迪埃斯
v. 给……染色；被着色（dye 的第三人称单数）

e.en: If something or someone is efficient, they are able to do tasks successfully, without wasting time or energy.

ex.en: With today's more efficient contraception women can plan their families and careers.
ex.zh: 有了当今更为高效的避孕方法妇女们能够规划好自己的家庭和事业。

e.en: 高效地

ex.en: I work very efficiently and am decisive, and accurate in my judgement.
ex.zh: 我工作高效、决策果断而且判断准确。

d: adj. 生效的，效率高的；（人）有能力的，能胜任的
第八代

e.en: If you embrace someone, you put your arms around them and hold them tightly, usually in order to show your love or affection for them. You can also say that two people embrace.

ex.en: Penelope came forward and embraced her sister.
ex.zh: 佩内洛普走上前来拥抱了她的妹妹。

ex.en: At first people were sort of crying for joy and embracing each other.
ex.zh: 开始时人们有点喜极而泣，互相拥抱。

e.en: Embrace is also a noun.

ex.en: ...a young couple locked in an embrace.
ex.zh: …紧紧相拥的年轻一对。

e.en: If you embrace a change, political system, or idea, you accept it and start supporting it or believing in it. 欣然接受;

ex.en: He embraces the new information age.
ex.zh: 他欢迎新的信息时代。

e.en: Embrace is also a noun. 欣然接受;

ex.en: The marriage signalled James's embrace of the Catholic faith.
ex.zh: 这场婚姻标志着詹姆士对天主教的信奉。

d: v. 拥抱；欣然接受，乐意采纳；包括，涉及（embrace 的过去式和过去分词）
n. 佛罗伦萨（意大利都市名）；弗洛伦斯（女子名）

e.en: An employee is a person who is paid to work for an organization or for another person.

ex.en: He is an employee of Fuji Bank.
ex.zh: 他是富士银行的一位雇员。

d: n. 员工，雇员，从业人员（employee 的复数）

e.en: the process of producing a metal component by hammering

d: n. 锻造；锻件；伪造
v. 伪造，假冒；锻造，制作；缔造，建立，努力加强；稳步前进（forge 的现在分词）

e.en: Goods are things that are made to be sold.

ex.en: Money can be exchanged for goods or services.
ex.zh: 钱可以用来换取商品或服务。

e.en: Your goods are the things that you own and that can be moved. 私人财产;

ex.en: You can give your unwanted goods to charity.
ex.zh: 你可以把不需要的东西捐给慈善机构。

d: n. 商品；动产，私人财产；（公路、铁路等运输的）货物；本领；正要寻找的人（或物）
n. 哈罗兹（英国著名百货公司）

e.en: A guide is a book that gives you information or instructions to help you do or understand something.

ex.en: Our 10-page guide will help you to change your life for the better.
ex.zh: 我们这本10页的指南将会帮助改善你们的生活。

e.en: A guide is a book that gives tourists information about a town, area, or country.

ex.en: The Rough Guide to Paris lists accommodations for as little as $35 a night.
ex.zh: 《巴黎旅游简明指南》列出了价格低至每晚$35的住宿。

e.en: A guide is someone who shows tourists around places such as museums or cities.

ex.en: We've arranged a walking tour of the city with your guide.
ex.zh: 我们已经和你的导游安排了一个城市步行游览。

e.en: If you guide someone around a city, museum, or building, you show it to them and explain points of interest.

ex.en: ...a young Egyptologist who guided us through tombs and temples with enthusiasm.
ex.zh: …一位热心地领着我们参观陵墓和寺庙的年轻的埃及学家。

d: v. 带领，引导（某人至某地）；任向导；指导，影响；解释，阐明
n. 指南，手册；导游，向导；准则，指针；女童子军，女童子军成员
【名】 （Guide）（法、葡）吉德（人名）
n. 赫伯恩（姓氏）；赫本（人名，常指奥黛丽·赫本或凯瑟琳·赫本）；黑本式（Hepburn romanization 的简称，日语罗马字转写系统）

e.en: The height of a person or thing is their size or length from the bottom to the top.

ex.en: Her weight is about normal for her height.
ex.zh: 按她的身高，她的体重大体正常。

ex.en: I am 5'6'' in height.
ex.zh: 我的身高是5英尺6英寸。

e.en: Height is the quality of being tall.

ex.en: She admits that her height is intimidating for some men.
ex.zh: 她承认自己的高个儿对一些男人而言是吓人的。

e.en: A particular height is the distance that something is above the ground or above something else mentioned.

ex.en: At the speed and height at which he was moving, he was never more than half a second from disaster.
ex.zh: 以这样的速度在这么高的地方移动，他离灾难永远只有半步之遥。

e.en: A height is a high position or place above the ground.

ex.en: I'm not afraid of heights.
ex.zh: 我不恐高。

d: n. 身高；高；高度；高处，高地；极佳状况；极端例子

e.en: A country's heritage is all the qualities, traditions, or features of life there that have continued over many years and have been passed on from one generation to another. 遗产;

ex.en: The historic building is as much part of our heritage as the paintings.
ex.zh: 这座历史建筑和这些绘画作品一样也是留给我们的遗产的组成部分。

d: n. 遗产，传统，世袭财产；（植物种类）纯种的，老品种的；特殊（或个人）的所有物，（该有的）一份；上帝选择的人（以色列人或基督教教会）
【名】 （Heritage）（英）赫里蒂奇（人名）
n. 高科技，高技术；高科技设计或产品；高技派（一种强调工业技术元素的建筑流派）
adj. 高科技的，高技术的；（建筑/设计）高技术风格的，高技派的
abbr. 高科技（high technology）

e.en: High-end products, especially electronic products, are the most expensive of their kind.

ex.en: ...high-end personal computers and computer workstations.
ex.zh: …高端个人电脑和电脑工作站。

d: adj. 高端的，高档的
adj. 最高的
adv. 最高地，最高
n. 豪厄尔（男子名）

e.en: If you describe something as immense, you mean that it is extremely large or great.

ex.en: ...an immense cloud of smoke.
ex.zh: …一大片烟云。

d: adj. 极大的，巨大的；非常好，极好；无边无际的

e.en: When you hold something, you carry or support it, using your hands or your arms. 拿着;

ex.en: Hold the knife at an angle.
ex.zh: 斜握着刀。

e.en: Hold is also a noun. 拿;

ex.en: He released his hold on the camera.
ex.zh: 他松开了握着照相机的手。

e.en: Hold is used in expressions such as grab hold of, catch hold of, and get hold of, to indicate that you close your hand tightly around something, for example to stop something moving or falling.

ex.en: I was woken up by someone grabbing hold of my sleeping bag.
ex.zh: 有人抓住我的睡袋把我弄醒了。

ex.en: A doctor and a nurse caught hold of his arms.
ex.zh: 一名医生和一名护士抓住了他的双臂。

e.en: When you hold someone, you put your arms around them, usually because you want to show them how much you like them or because you want to comfort them. (常因想表示喜爱和安慰而)

ex.en: If only he would hold her close to him.
ex.zh: 他要是紧紧抱住她就好了。

d: v. hold 的第三人称单数形式：把握，握住，抓住；抱住；使保持；容纳；保存；持有；认为；举行；（用于 holds true / holds good）仍然有效，适用
n. hold 的复数：货舱（船舶或飞机上装载货物、行李的舱室）；抓握点，支撑物（尤指攀岩墙、岩壁上的岩点）
n. 伊恩（男子名）
adj. 有几十年历史的，存在了几十年的，长达数十年的

e.en: If you have to contend with a problem or difficulty, you have to deal with it or overcome it.

ex.en: It is time, once again, to contend with racism.
ex.zh: 又是对付种族主义的时候了。

e.en: If you contend that something is true, you state or argue that it is true.

ex.en: The government contends that he is fundamentalist.
ex.zh: 政府辩称他是原教旨主义者。

e.en: If you contend with someone for something such as power, you compete with them to try to get it. 争夺 (权力等)

ex.en: ...the two main groups contending for power.
ex.zh: …争夺权力的两大主要集团。

ex.en: Small-market clubs such as the Kansas City Royals have had trouble contending with richer teams for championships.
ex.zh: 像堪萨斯城皇家队这样市场规模较小的俱乐部一直难以同财力更雄厚的球队争夺冠军。

d: v. 声称，主张；竞争，争夺；处理，对付

e.en: Republican means relating to a republic. In republican systems of government, power is held by the people or the representatives that they elect.

ex.en: ...the nations that had adopted the republican form of government.
ex.zh: …采用了共和制政体的国家。

e.en: If someone is Republican, they belong to or support the Republican Party.

ex.en: Lower taxes made Republican voters happier with their party.
ex.zh: 更低的税率使共和党选民对该党更加满意。

e.en: A Republican is someone who supports or belongs to the Republican Party.

ex.en: What made you decide to become a Republican, as opposed to a Democrat?
ex.zh: 是什么使你决定成为共和党人，而不是民主党人呢？

d: n. （常大写）共和党人，共和党党员（美国共和党成员或支持者；the Republicans 也指美国共和党）；拥护共和政体的人，共和派人士（republican 的复数形式，常小写）

e.en: If someone violates an agreement, law, or promise, they break it.

ex.en: They went to prison because they violated the law.
ex.zh: 他们因犯法而入狱。

e.en: 违反

ex.en: To deprive the boy of his education is a violation of state law.
ex.zh: 剥夺这个男孩的受教育权是一种违反州法律的行为。

e.en: If you violate someone's privacy or peace, you disturb it.

ex.en: These men were violating her family's privacy.
ex.zh: 这些男人在侵犯她的家庭隐私。

e.en: If someone violates a special place such as a grave, they damage it or treat it with disrespect.

ex.en: Detectives are still searching for those who violated the graveyard.
ex.zh: 侦探们还在查找那些亵渎了墓地的家伙。

d: v. 违反，违背；侵犯，侵扰；亵渎，玷污（violate 的过去式和过去分词）
adj. 被违反的，被侵犯的；被亵渎的

e.en: A midterm election is an election that takes place approximately halfway through a president's or a government's term of office.

ex.en: Bush's Republican Party faces a tough challenge in midterm congressional elections in November.
ex.zh: 布什的共和党在11月中期国会选举中面临艰难的挑战。

e.en: A midterm or a midterm exam is a test which a student takes in the middle of a school or college term.

ex.en: She was about to walk into a midterm exam for a subject she knew very little about.
ex.zh: 她马上就要参加一个她知之甚少的科目的期中考试了。

d: n. 期中考试：在学期中举行的考试，通常用于评估学生在该学期的学业表现；美国中期选举：在总统任期中期举行的美国国会选举，选出全部联邦众议员和约三分之一联邦参议员。

e.en: If you seek something such as a job or a place to live, you try to find one.

ex.en: They have had to seek work as labourers.
ex.zh: 他们只好找体力活来做。

ex.en: Four people who sought refuge in the Italian embassy have left voluntarily.
ex.zh: 到意大利大使馆寻求避难的四个人已经自愿离开了。

e.en: When someone seeks something, they try to obtain it.

ex.en: The prosecutors have warned they will seek the death penalty.
ex.zh: 原告已警告说他们会努力争取死刑。

e.en: If you seek someone's help or advice, you contact them in order to ask for it. 请求;

ex.en: Always seek professional legal advice before entering into any agreement.
ex.zh: 在签订任何协议之前，一定要征求法律专家的意见。

ex.en: On important issues, they seek a second opinion.
ex.zh: 在重要问题上，他们都征求别人的意见。

e.en: If you seek to do something, you try to do it. 力图;

ex.en: He also denied that he would seek to annex the country.
ex.zh: 他还否认了他企图并吞该国。

d: v. 寻找，寻求；谋求，争取；征求，请求；力图，设法（seek 的现在分词/动名词）
n. 搜寻，寻求；获得某物的尝试
adj. 追求…的，寻求…的（常构成 profit-seeking、self-seeking 等复合词）

e.en: A drug is a chemical which is given to people in order to treat or prevent an illness or disease.

ex.en: The drug will be useful to hundreds of thousands of infected people.
ex.zh: 这种药物将会对成千上万感染者有用。

e.en: Drugs are substances that some people take because of their pleasant effects, but which are usually illegal.

ex.en: His mother was on drugs, on cocaine.
ex.zh: 他的母亲吸毒，吸可卡因。

ex.en: She was sure Leo was taking drugs.
ex.zh: 她肯定利奥在吸毒。

e.en: If you drug a person or animal, you give them a chemical substance in order to make them sleepy or unconscious.

ex.en: She was drugged and robbed.
ex.zh: 她被下了迷药，遭到抢劫。

e.en: If food or drink is drugged, a chemical substance is added to it in order to make someone sleepy or unconscious when they eat or drink it. 下麻醉药于 (食物或饮料)

ex.en: I wonder now if that drink had been drugged.
ex.zh: 我现在怀疑那饮料是否已被人下了麻醉药。

d: n. 毒品；药物；运动禁药；成瘾之事
v. 使服麻醉药；（在食物或饮料中）投放麻醉药；吸毒
【名】 （Drug）（罗）德鲁格（人名）

e.en: If you expedite something, you cause it to be done more quickly.

ex.en: We tried to help you expedite your plans.
ex.zh: 我们试图帮你加快你的计划。

d: adj. （正式，常作定语）加急的，加快的，从速办理的
v. （expedite 的过去式和过去分词）加快，促进；迅速执行；派送，发送（文件等）

e.en: To emerge means to come out from an enclosed or dark space such as a room or a vehicle, or from a position where you could not be seen. (从视线以外的地方) 出现;

ex.en: Richard was waiting outside the door as she emerged.
ex.zh: 当她出现的时候，理查德正等候在门外。

ex.en: She then emerged from the courthouse to thank her supporters.
ex.zh: 于是她从法院大楼出来向支持者们表示感谢。

e.en: If you emerge from a difficult or bad experience, you come to the end of it.

ex.en: There is growing evidence that the economy is at last emerging from recession.
ex.zh: 有越来越多的迹象表明经济将最终摆脱萧条。

e.en: If a fact or result emerges from a period of thought, discussion, or investigation, it becomes known as a result of it. 显露 (事实、结果)

ex.en: ...the growing corruption that has emerged in the past few years.
ex.zh: …过去几年中暴露出来的日趋严重的腐败。

ex.en: It soon emerged that neither the July nor August mortgage payment had been collected.
ex.zh: 很快显示的是7月和8月的抵押款都没有被收取。

e.en: If someone or something emerges as a particular thing, they become recognized as that thing.

ex.en: Vietnam has emerged as the world's third-biggest rice exporter.
ex.zh: 越南已立足成为世界第三大稻米出口国。

d: adj. 新兴的，发展初期的
v. 浮现，出现；显露，知悉；恢复过来，幸存下来（emerge 的现在分词）

e.en: Clinical means involving or relating to the direct medical treatment or testing of patients.

ex.en: The first clinical trials were expected to begin next year.
ex.zh: 第一批临床试验预计明年开始。

e.en: 临床地

ex.en: She was diagnosed as being clinically depressed.
ex.zh: 她被诊断为患临床抑郁症。

e.en: You use clinical to describe thought or behaviour that is very logical and does not involve any emotion.

ex.en: All this questioning is so clinical – it kills romance.
ex.zh: 所有这些发问是如此如此无人情味–使浪漫荡然无存。

d: adj. 诊所的，医务室的；临床的，临床诊断的；冷静的，无感情的；简陋的，无装饰的；精确的，娴熟的

e.en: FDA is an abbreviation for . 食品及药物管理局; Food and Drug Administration

ex.en: The FDA has approved a new treatment for a rare blood disorder.
ex.zh: 食品及药物管理局通过了一种罕见血液疾病的新疗法。

d: abbr. （美）食品及药物管理局（Food and Drug Administration）
n. 杰里米（男子名，为《圣经》人名耶利米的英语变体）

e.en: A pathway is a path that you can walk along or a route that you can take.

ex.en: Richard was coming up the pathway.
ex.zh: 理查德正沿路走来。

e.en: A pathway is a particular course of action or a way of achieving something.

ex.en: Diplomacy will smooth your pathway to success.
ex.zh: 良好的交际会铺平你的成功之路。

d: n. 路，道；途径，路径；神经通路；（生物化学）通路

e.en: When you test something, you try it, for example, by touching it or using it for a short time, in order to find out what it is, what condition it is in, or how well it works.

ex.en: Either measure the temperature with a thermometer or test the water with your wrist.
ex.zh: 要么用温度计测量水温，要么用你的手腕来试水温。

e.en: A test is a deliberate action or experiment to find out how well something works.

ex.en: ...the banning of nuclear tests.
ex.zh: …对核试验的禁止。

e.en: If you test someone, you ask them questions or tell them to perform certain actions in order to find out how much they know about a subject or how well they are able to do something.

ex.en: There was a time when each teacher spent an hour, one day a week, testing students in every subject.
ex.zh: 曾有一段时间，每个老师每周都花一小时来测验学生的各门功课。

e.en: A test is a series of questions that you must answer or actions that you must perform in order to show how much you know about a subject or how well you are able to do something.

ex.en: Out of a total of 25 students only 15 passed the test.
ex.zh: 所有25个学生中只有15个通过了测试。

d: n. 测验，考试，测试；（技术、医学）试验，检测，化验（均为 test 的复数）
v. 测验，测试，检验；考验（均为 test 的第三人称单数）

e.en: A threat to a person or thing is a danger that something bad might happen to them. A threat is also the cause of this danger. 威胁;

ex.en: Some couples see single women as a threat to their relationships.
ex.zh: 有些夫妇把单身女子看作是对他们夫妻关系的一种威胁。

e.en: A threat is a statement by someone that they will hurt you in some way, especially if you do not do what they want.

ex.en: He may be forced to carry out his threat to resign.
ex.zh: 他可能会迫不得已将自己扬言要辞职的威胁付诸实施。

e.en: If a person or thing is under threat, there is a danger that something bad might be done to them, or that they might cease to exist.

ex.en: His position as leader is under threat.
ex.zh: 他的领导职位受到威胁。

d: n. 威胁，恐吓；危险，风险（threat 的复数）
v. 威胁，恐吓（threat 的第三人称单数，罕见或陈旧用法）

e.en: When you write, you use something such as a pen or pencil to produce words, letters, or numbers.

ex.en: Simply write your name and address on a postcard and send it to us.
ex.zh: 只要在明信片上写下你的名字和地址，然后寄给我们。

ex.en: They were still trying to teach her to read and write.
ex.zh: 他们当时仍在试图教她读书写字。

e.en: If you write something such as a book, a poem, or a piece of music, you create it and record it on paper or perhaps on a computer.

ex.en: I had written quite a lot of orchestral music in my student days.
ex.zh: 我在学生时代创作了许多管弦乐曲。

ex.en: Thereafter she wrote articles for papers and magazines in Paris.
ex.zh: 从那以后，她为巴黎的报纸和杂志撰稿。

e.en: Someone who writes creates books, stories, or articles, usually for publication.

ex.en: Jay wanted to write.
ex.zh: 杰伊那时想搞创作。

e.en: When you write someone or to someone or write them a letter, you give them information, ask them something, or express your feelings in a letter. 写 (信)

ex.en: Apparently she had written to her aunt in Holland asking for advice.
ex.zh: 显然，她已给她荷兰的姑妈写信征求意见了。

ex.en: She had written him a note a couple of weeks earlier.
ex.zh: 两周前她曾给他写过一张便条。

d: v. 写作，编写；写道；写信；书写，写字；谱写（音乐作品）；编写（计算机程序）；将（计算机中的）数据写入（磁盘或其他储存媒体）；填写（表格、支票等），拟定；（笔）能写字；拼写；参加（笔试）；书写，手写（与铅印相对）；以写作为生；承保（保险单）

e.en: A species is a class of plants or animals whose members have the same main characteristics and are able to breed with each other.

ex.en: Pandas are an endangered species.
ex.zh: 大熊猫是一种濒危物种。

d: n. （动植物的）种，物种；种类；（具有相同特征的）一类人；（化学，物理）核素；（圣餐中用的）面包和圣酒
adj. 原种的
adj. 短颈的：颈部较短的。

e.en: A beetle is an insect with a hard covering to its body.
a heavy hand tool, usually made of wood, used for ramming, pounding, or beating
to scuttle or scurry; hurry
to overhang; jut

d: n. 甲虫；画甲虫，拼甲虫（一种掷骰子游戏）；大槌；捶布机；（大众汽车公司生产的）甲壳虫汽车（Beetle）
v. 匆匆地走；（人的眉毛）突出，悬垂；用大槌捶；用捶布机捶（布）
adj. （人的眉毛）粗浓而突出
【名】 （Beetle）（美）比特尔（人名）

e.en: A bee is an insect with a yellow-and-black striped body that makes a buzzing noise as it flies. Bees make honey, and can sting.

ex.en: A bee buzzed in the flowers.
ex.zh: 一只蜜蜂在花丛中嗡嗡作响。

e.en: a social gathering for a specific purpose, as to carry out a communal task or hold competitions 聚会;

ex.en: quilting bee

d: n. （蜂）蜜蜂，蜂类（bee 的复数）
n. （生物学）幼虫，幼体（larva 的复数）

e.en: Oil is a smooth, thick liquid that is used as a fuel and for making the parts of machines move smoothly. Oil is found underground.

ex.en: The company buys and sells about 600,000 barrels of oil a day.
ex.zh: 这家公司一天买卖约六十万桶石油。

ex.en: ...the rapid rise in prices for oil and petrol.
ex.zh: …石油和汽油价格的飙涨。

e.en: If you oil something, you put oil onto or into it, for example, to make it work smoothly or to protect it.

ex.en: A crew of assistants oiled and adjusted the release mechanism until it worked perfectly.
ex.zh: 助手们给排放装置加了润滑油并做了调节，直到其运转良好。

e.en: Oil is a smooth, thick liquid made from plants and is often used for cooking.

ex.en: Combine the beans, chopped mint, and oil in a large bowl.
ex.zh: 将豆子、剁碎的薄荷和植物油混在一个大碗里。

e.en: Oil is a smooth, thick liquid, often with a pleasant smell, that you rub into your skin or add to your bath. 润肤油;

ex.en: Try a hot bath with some relaxing bath oil.
ex.zh: 试试用点儿放松身心的沐浴液洗个热水澡吧。

d: n. 燃油，润滑油；石油，原油；润肤油，护发油；食用油；油性涂料，油画颜料（oils）；油画；信息，事实
v. 加油于……，给……加润滑油；给（皮肤）涂油，抹油

e.en: If a person or living thing survives in a dangerous situation such as an accident or an illness, they do not die.

ex.en: ...the sequence of events that left the eight pupils battling to survive in icy seas for over four hours.
ex.zh: …使4名小学生在冰冷的海洋中挣扎求生超过4个小时的一连串事件。

ex.en: Those organisms that are most suited to the environment will be those that will survive.
ex.zh: 那些最适应环境的生物将是那些存活下来的。

e.en: If you survive in difficult circumstances, you manage to live or continue in spite of them and do not let them affect you very much.

ex.en: On my first day here I thought, "Ooh, how will I survive?"
ex.zh: 在这儿的第一天我想：“噢，我该怎么挺过去呀？”

ex.en: ...people who are struggling to survive without jobs.
ex.zh: …挣扎着以挺过失业的人们。

e.en: If something survives, it continues to exist even after being in a dangerous situation or existing for a long time.

ex.en: When the market economy is introduced, many factories will not survive.
ex.zh: 一旦推行市场经济，很多工厂将无法存活下去。

ex.en: No one survived the crash.
ex.zh: 无人在这次撞击中幸免于难。

e.en: If you survive someone, you continue to live after they have died.

ex.en: Most women will survive their spouses.
ex.zh: 大多数女性比她们的配偶活得长。

d: v. （经历事故、战争或疾病后）活下来，幸存；比……活得久，比……长寿；挺过，艰难度过；幸免于难，留存；（靠很少的钱）继续维持生活；设法对付（困难或令人不愉快的事）

e.en: An adult is a mature, fully developed person. An adult has reached the age when they are legally responsible for their actions.

ex.en: Becoming a father signified that he was now an adult.
ex.zh: 成为一名父亲意味着他现在是一个成年人了。

e.en: An adult is a fully developed animal.

ex.en: ...a pair of adult birds.
ex.zh: …一对成鸟。

e.en: Adult means relating to the time when you are an adult, or typical of adult people.

ex.en: I've lived most of my adult life in Arizona.
ex.zh: 我已在亚利桑那州度过了我大部分的成年生活。

e.en: You can describe things such as films or books as adult when they deal with sex in a very clear and open way. (电影、书籍等)

ex.en: ...an adult film.
ex.zh: …一部成人电影。

d: n. 成年人（adult 的复数形式）；（生物学）成年动物（adult 的复数形式，如成虫、成体）

e.en: A beetle is an insect with a hard covering to its body.
a heavy hand tool, usually made of wood, used for ramming, pounding, or beating
to scuttle or scurry; hurry
to overhang; jut

d: n. 甲虫，甲壳虫（beetle 的复数）；木槌（beetle 的复数）
v. 忙碌地来回走；快步走；用木槌捶；（人的眉毛）突出（beetle 的第三人称单数）

e.en: You say that something is amazing when it is very surprising and makes you feel pleasure, approval, or wonder.

ex.en: It's amazing what we can remember with a little prompting.
ex.zh: 只需一点提示我们就能想起很多东西真是令人吃惊。

e.en: 令人惊诧地

ex.en: She was an amazingly good cook.
ex.zh: 她曾是个好得惊人的厨师。

d: adj. 惊人的，了不起的；令人诧异的，令人惊愕的；令人高兴的
v. 使惊奇，使惊愕（amaze 的现在分词形式）

e.en: The habitat of an animal or plant is the natural environment in which it normally lives or grows.

ex.en: In its natural habitat, the hibiscus will grow up to 25 ft.
ex.zh: 在其野生环境中，木槿能长25英尺。

d: n. （动植物的）生活环境，栖息地
【名】 （Habitat）（德）哈比塔特（人名）

e.en: You can refer to any living thing that is not a plant as a creature, especially when it is of an unknown or unfamiliar kind. People also refer to imaginary animals and beings as creatures. (尤指不明的或想像中的) 生物;

ex.en: Alaskan Eskimos believe that every living creature possesses a spirit.
ex.zh: 阿拉斯加的爱斯基摩人认为每个活着的动物都有灵魂。

d: n. 生物，动物；（具有某种特征的）人；怪物；受支配的人，产物
北莱茵-威斯特法伦州（North Rhine-Westphalia）
无收益水（Non-revenue water）
n. 彭布罗克郡（位于威尔士西南部）

e.en: Something that is rare is not common and is therefore interesting or valuable.

ex.en: ...the black-necked crane, one of the rarest species in the world.
ex.zh: …黑颈鹤，世界上最珍稀的物种之一。

e.en: An event or situation that is rare does not occur very often.

ex.en: ...on those rare occasions when he did eat alone.
ex.zh: …在他独自吃饭的那些不常有的时候。

e.en: You use rare to emphasize an extremely good or remarkable quality. 极好的 (素质)

ex.en: Ferris has a rare ability to record her observations on paper.
ex.zh: 费里斯有将自己的观察结果以书面形式记录下来的杰出能力。

e.en: Meat that is rare is cooked very lightly so that the inside is still red. (肉类)

ex.en: Thick tuna steaks are eaten rare, like beef.
ex.zh: 厚厚的金枪鱼片要半熟吃，就像牛肉一样。

d: adj. 少见的，不常发生的；稀罕的，珍贵的；半熟的，半生的；（品质）极好的，杰出的；（空气）稀薄的，缺氧的；非常的，极度的

e.en: If you rediscover something good or valuable that you had forgotten or lost, you become aware of it again or find it again.

ex.en: ...a one-time rebel who had rediscovered his faith.
ex.zh: ...重新发现了自己信仰的一个曾经的反叛者。

d: v. 重新发现，重新找到（rediscover 的过去式和过去分词）

e.en: A person or animal that is solitary spends a lot of time alone.

ex.en: Paul was a shy, pleasant, solitary man.
ex.zh: 保罗是个腼腆的、讨人喜欢的、惯于独处的人。

e.en: A solitary activity is one that you do alone.

ex.en: His evenings were spent in solitary drinking.
ex.zh: 他的每个夜晚都在独自饮酒中度过。

e.en: A solitary person or object is alone, with no others near them.

ex.en: You could see the occasional solitary figure making a study of wildflowers or grasses.
ex.zh: 你偶尔可以看见那个研究野生花草的孤独身影。

d: adj. 独自的，单独的；偏僻的，孤立的；独自完成的；（人或动物）独处的，独居的；（花或其他部分）单生的；唯一的，仅有的
n. 单独监禁；独居者，隐士

e.en: the raised mark left on the skin after the stroke of a rod or whip 棒痕;
to raise a wale or wales on by striking 打出棒痕;
a choice
choice

d: n. 威尔士（英国大不列颠岛西南部地区，通常大写为 Wales）；wale 的复数形式：鞭痕，棒痕；（织物等的）棱纹，凸条
v. wale 的第三人称单数现在时形式：在……上打出鞭痕；（苏格兰用语）挑选，选择

e.en: Your ability to do something is the fact that you can do it.

ex.en: The public never had faith in his ability to handle the job.
ex.zh: 公众从来都不相信他有处理这个工作的能力。

e.en: Your ability is the quality or skill that you have which makes it possible for you to do something.

ex.en: Her drama teacher spotted her ability.
ex.zh: 她的戏剧老师发现了她的才能。

ex.en: Does the school cater to all abilities?
ex.zh: 这所学校满足各水平才能的人吗?

e.en: If you do something to the best of your abilities or to the best of your ability, you do it as well as you can.

ex.en: I take care of them to the best of my abilities.
ex.zh: 我尽全力照顾他们。

d: n. 能力，能够；才能，技能，本领

e.en: Adulthood is the state of being an adult.

ex.en: Few people nowadays are able to maintain friendships into adulthood.
ex.zh: 现今很少有人能够把友谊维持到成年。

d: n. 成年，成人时期

e.en: An adult is a mature, fully developed person. An adult has reached the age when they are legally responsible for their actions.

ex.en: Becoming a father signified that he was now an adult.
ex.zh: 成为一名父亲意味着他现在是一个成年人了。

e.en: An adult is a fully developed animal.

ex.en: ...a pair of adult birds.
ex.zh: …一对成鸟。

e.en: Adult means relating to the time when you are an adult, or typical of adult people.

ex.en: I've lived most of my adult life in Arizona.
ex.zh: 我已在亚利桑那州度过了我大部分的成年生活。

e.en: You can describe things such as films or books as adult when they deal with sex in a very clear and open way. (电影、书籍等)

ex.en: ...an adult film.
ex.zh: …一部成人电影。

d: n. 成年人或动物
adj. 成年的，发育成熟的；成人的，理智的；（电影、杂志等）仅限于成人的
v. 像成年人一样表现；变成熟

e.en: If someone is alarmed, they feel afraid or anxious that something unpleasant or dangerous might happen.

ex.en: They should not be too alarmed by the press reports.
ex.zh: 他们不应该被媒体报道搞得过于恐慌。

d: adj. 担忧的，惊恐的；有警报装置的
v. 报警（alarm 的过去式和过去分词）

e.en: a former Indian copper coin, worth one sixteenth of a rupee 安那; 印度旧时的货币单位，等于1卢布的1/16

d: n. 安那（印度旧时的货币单位，等于1卢布的1/16）
n. （Anna）安娜（女子名）

e.en: any plant of the genus Aster, having white, blue, purple, or pink daisy-like flowers: family Asteraceae (composites)

d: n. （植）紫菀属植物（亦泛指同类菊状观赏植物）；（细胞）星状体；（人名）阿斯特尔（Aster，德、意、捷）
abbr. （遥感）先进星载热发射和反射辐射计（ASTER，全称 Advanced Spaceborne Thermal Emission and Reflection Radiometer）

e.en: A batch of things or people is a group of things or people of the same kind, especially a group that is dealt with at the same time or is sent to a particular place at the same time. (一)

ex.en: ...the current batch of trainee priests.
ex.zh: …当前的这一批受训牧师。

ex.en: She brought a large batch of newspaper clippings.
ex.zh: 她带来一大批剪报。

e.en: the amount of a material needed for an operation
e.zh: 一次手术所需的材料数

e.en: a tall loaf having a close texture and a thick crust on the top and bottom, baked as part of a batch: the sides of each loaf are greased so that they will pull apart after baking to have pale crumby sides; made esp in Scotland and Ireland 一大条面包 (Also called batch loaf)
to group (items) for efficient processing (为提高处理效率而进行的)

d: n. 一批，一批生产量
v. 分批处理
【名】 （Batch）（英）巴奇（人名）

e.en: A bee is an insect with a yellow-and-black striped body that makes a buzzing noise as it flies. Bees make honey, and can sting.

ex.en: A bee buzzed in the flowers.
ex.zh: 一只蜜蜂在花丛中嗡嗡作响。

e.en: a social gathering for a specific purpose, as to carry out a communal task or hold competitions 聚会;

ex.en: quilting bee

d: n. 蜜蜂；聚会，联谊赛；工作忙碌的人（busy bee）
【名】 （Bee）（英）比，（赤几）贝埃（人名）

e.en: If someone says that a person has breeding, they mean that they think the person is from a good social background and has good manners.

ex.en: It's a sign of good breeding to know the names of all your staff.
ex.zh: 知道你所有职员的名字是有良好教养的表现。

d: n. 繁殖，生育；（动物的）饲养，（植物的）培植；教养
v. 交配繁殖；饲养，培育；养育，培养（breed 的现在分词）
【名】 （Breeding）（英）布里丁（人名）

e.en: If you are on the brink of something, usually something important, terrible, or exciting, you are just about to do it or experience it.

ex.en: Their economy is teetering on the brink of collapse.
ex.zh: 他们的经济正摇摆于崩溃的边缘。

d: n. 边缘
【名】 （Brink）（英、德、荷、丹、瑞典）布林克（人名）
n．一家英国非营利性环保组织，致力于保护昆虫及其栖息地，以维护生物多样性和生态系统健康。

e.en: A bug is an insect or similar small creature.

ex.en: We noticed tiny bugs that were all over the walls.
ex.zh: 我们发现墙上爬满了小虫。

e.en: A bug is an illness which is caused by small organisms such as bacteria. (由细菌引起的)

ex.en: I think I've got a bit of a stomach bug.
ex.zh: 我觉得我有点肠胃感染。

e.en: If there is a bug in a computer program, there is a mistake in it. (计算机程序的)

ex.en: There is a bug in the software.
ex.zh: 软件出了故障。

e.en: A bug is a tiny hidden microphone that transmits what people are saying.

ex.en: There was a bug on the phone.
ex.zh: 那部电话里装有一个微型窃听器。

d: n. 昆虫，虫子；小病，轻微的传染病；（计算机程序中的）漏洞，故障；窃听器；热衷，着迷
v. 烦扰，使恼怒；装窃听器；（由于吃惊或害怕）张大眼睛，瞪大双眼

e.en: A bumblebee is a large hairy bee.

d: n. 熊蜂（Bombus 属，俗称“大黄蜂”），一种体型较大、多毛、常黄黑相间的社会性蜂类；《变形金刚》系列中的汽车人（博派）角色 Bumblebee，中文通称“大黄蜂”
n. 梳刷的人；起毛工人
n. （Carder）人名；（英、西、罗）卡德尔

e.en: A class is a group of students who are taught together.

ex.en: He had to spend about six months in a class with younger students.
ex.zh: 他不得不在一个比他小的学生的班上呆了大约六个月。

e.en: A class is a course of teaching in a particular subject.

ex.en: He acquired a law degree by taking classes at night.
ex.zh: 他通过上晚上的课获得了法律学位。

e.en: A class of things is a group of them with similar characteristics.

ex.en: Harbour staff noticed that measurements given for the same class of boats often varied.
ex.zh: 港口员工们注意到对同一类小船所给出的尺寸经常不同。

e.en: If you do something in class, you do it during a lesson in school.

ex.en: There is lots of reading in class.
ex.zh: 课上有大量阅读。

d: v. class 的过去式和过去分词，表示“将…归类或分级”

e.en: If you carry something, you take it with you, holding it so that it does not touch the ground. 提;

ex.en: He was carrying a briefcase.
ex.zh: 他提着公文包。

ex.en: She carried her son to the car.
ex.zh: 她抱着儿子向车走去。

e.en: If you carry something, you have it with you wherever you go.

ex.en: You have to carry a pager so that they can call you in at any time.
ex.zh: 你得带个传呼机，以便他们随时可以联系到你。

e.en: If something carries a person or thing somewhere, it takes them there.

ex.en: Flowers are designed to attract insects which then carry the pollen from plant to plant.
ex.zh: 花儿天生就能吸引昆虫，昆虫则在植物之间传递花粉。

ex.en: The delegation was carrying a message of thanks to President Mubarak.
ex.zh: 代表团向穆巴拉克总统传达谢意。

e.en: If a person or animal is carrying a disease, they are infected with it and can pass it on to other people or animals. 携带 (病毒)

ex.en: The test could be used to screen healthy people to see if they are carrying the virus.
ex.zh: 这项测试可以用来检查健康人群，看他们是否携带该病毒。

d: v. 拿；提；搬；扛；背；抱；运送；携带；传播（carry 的过去式和过去分词）

e.en: If you conserve a supply of something, you use it carefully so that it lasts for a long time.

ex.en: The factories have closed for the weekend to conserve energy.
ex.zh: 这些工厂在那个周末关了厂以节省能源。

e.en: To conserve something means to protect it from harm, loss, or change.

ex.en: ...a big increase in U.S. aid to help developing countries conserve their forests.
ex.zh: …美国对帮助发展中国家保护森林的援助的大幅增加。

d: v. 保护，保存；节省，节约；使（量，如能量、质量）守恒；将……制成蜜饯
n. 蜜饯，果脯

e.en: A conservationist is someone who cares very much about the conservation of the environment and who works to protect it.

ex.en: Conservationists say the law must be strengthened.
ex.zh: 环保主义者称必须加强法制。

d: n. （自然环境、野生动植物等）保护主义者，环保人士

e.en: The coverage of something in the news is the reporting of it.

ex.en: Now a special TV network gives live coverage of most races.
ex.zh: 现在一个专门的电视网对大多数比赛进行现场报道。

d: n. 覆盖范围；新闻报道；保险范围；课程内容；防守，盯守

e.en: If you say that one thing depends on another, you mean that the first thing will be affected or determined by the second.

ex.en: The cooking time needed depends on the size of the potato.
ex.zh: 烹饪时间长短取决于土豆的大小。

e.en: If you depend on someone or something, you need them in order to be able to survive physically, financially, or emotionally.

ex.en: He depended on his writing for his income.
ex.zh: 他靠写作谋生。

e.en: If you can depend on a person, organization, or law, you know that they will support you or help you when you need them.

ex.en: "You can depend on me," Cross assured him.
ex.zh: “你可以信任我，”克罗斯向他保证。

e.en: You use depend in expressions such as it depends to indicate that you cannot give a clear answer to a question because the answer will be affected or determined by other factors.

ex.en: "But how long can you stay in the house?"—"I don't know. It depends."
ex.zh: “但你能在这屋里待多久？” — “不知道，这要看情况而定。”

d: v. （depend 的第三人称单数）与 on/upon 连用：取决于，视…而定；依靠，依赖；信赖，信任；（it depends / that depends）看情况，视情况而定

e.en: a bland processed meat in sausage form, eaten cold in slices 香肠状的淡而无味的加工过的肉;

d: n. 德文郡（等于 Devon shire, 英国郡名）；德文岛（加拿大北部）

e.en: A dog is a very common four-legged animal that is often kept by people as a pet or to guard or hunt. There are many different breeds of dog.

ex.en: The British are renowned as a nation of dog lovers.
ex.zh: 英国人以爱狗著称。

e.en: People use dog to refer to something that they consider unsatisfactory or of poor quality.

ex.en: It's a real dog.
ex.zh: 这是个不折不扣的蹩脚货。

e.en: If problems or injuries dog you, they are with you all the time. (问题、伤病等)

ex.en: His career has been dogged by bad luck.
ex.zh: 他的职业生涯厄运不断。

e.en: You use dog eat dog to express your disapproval of a situation where everyone wants to succeed and is willing to harm other people in order to do so.

ex.en: It is very much dog eat dog out there.
ex.zh: 那简直就是自相倾轧。

d: n. 狗，犬；公狗，公狐，公狼；质量极差的东西；卑鄙小人，无赖；朋友
v. 困扰，纠缠；跟踪，尾随

e.en: Something that is effective works well and produces the results that were intended.

ex.en: The project looks at how we could be more effective in encouraging students to enter teacher training.
ex.zh: 该项目研究如何更有效地鼓励学生参加教师培训。

ex.en: Simple antibiotics are effective against this organism.
ex.zh: 普通的抗生素就能够有效地抑制这种微生物。

e.en: 有效地

ex.en: Services need to be organized more effectively than they are at present.
ex.zh: 服务需要比现在更有效地被组织起来。

e.en: Effective means having a particular role or result in practice, though not officially or in theory.

ex.en: They have had effective control of the area since the security forces left.
ex.zh: 自从安全部队离开后，他们实际控制了这一地区。

e.en: When something such as a law or an agreement becomes effective, it begins officially to apply or be valid. (法律、协议等)

ex.en: The new rules will become effective in the next few days.
ex.zh: 这些新条例将在接下来的几天内生效。

d: adj. 产生预期结果的，有效的；实际的，事实上的；（法律、规则等）生效的，起作用的；给人深刻印象的
n. 实际可作战的士兵

e.en: Driven is the past participle of . (drive)

d: adj. （人）有紧迫感的，奋发努力的；受（某因素或感情）驱使的，由……决定的；由（某人或某种动力）操纵（或驱动、控制）的；（雪）飘积的，吹积的
v. 驾驶，开车；（汽车）行驶；驱赶，驱使（drive的过去分词）

e.en: To endanger something or someone means to put them in a situation where they might be harmed or destroyed completely.

ex.en: The debate could endanger the proposed Mideast peace talks.
ex.zh: 这场争论可能会危害中东和谈的倡议。

d: adj. （动植物）濒危的

e.en: To emerge means to come out from an enclosed or dark space such as a room or a vehicle, or from a position where you could not be seen. (从视线以外的地方) 出现;

ex.en: Richard was waiting outside the door as she emerged.
ex.zh: 当她出现的时候，理查德正等候在门外。

ex.en: She then emerged from the courthouse to thank her supporters.
ex.zh: 于是她从法院大楼出来向支持者们表示感谢。

e.en: If you emerge from a difficult or bad experience, you come to the end of it.

ex.en: There is growing evidence that the economy is at last emerging from recession.
ex.zh: 有越来越多的迹象表明经济将最终摆脱萧条。

e.en: If a fact or result emerges from a period of thought, discussion, or investigation, it becomes known as a result of it. 显露 (事实、结果)

ex.en: ...the growing corruption that has emerged in the past few years.
ex.zh: …过去几年中暴露出来的日趋严重的腐败。

ex.en: It soon emerged that neither the July nor August mortgage payment had been collected.
ex.zh: 很快显示的是7月和8月的抵押款都没有被收取。

e.en: If someone or something emerges as a particular thing, they become recognized as that thing.

ex.en: Vietnam has emerged as the world's third-biggest rice exporter.
ex.zh: 越南已立足成为世界第三大稻米出口国。

d: v. 浮现，出现；显露，知悉；恢复过来，幸存下来；形成，兴起

e.en: If you say that something is fab, you are emphasizing that you think it is very good. 极好的;

ex.en: The dancing is fab.
ex.zh: 舞跳得好极了。

e.en: an expression of approval or enthusiasm 太好了;

d: abbr. 外事局（Foreign Affairs Bureau）

e.en: The extinction of a species of animal or plant is the death of all its remaining living members. (物种的)

ex.en: An operation is beginning to try to save a species of crocodile from extinction.
ex.zh: 一项行动正在展开来拯救一个鳄鱼种类使其免遭灭绝。

e.en: If someone refers to the extinction of a way of life or type of activity, they mean that the way of life or activity stops existing. (生活方式、活动的)

ex.en: The loggers say their jobs are faced with extinction because of declining timber sales.
ex.zh: 樵夫们说他们的工作因不断下降的木材销售而面临消亡。

d: n. 灭绝，消亡；（债务的）偿清；消光

e.en: A flower is the part of a plant which is often brightly coloured, grows at the end of a stem, and only survives for a short time. 花 (朵)

ex.en: Each individual flower is tiny.
ex.zh: 每一朵花都很小。

e.en: A flower is a stem of a plant that has one or more flowers on it and has been picked, usually with others, for example, to give as a present or to put in a vase. 花 (株)

ex.en: ...a bunch of flowers sent by a new admirer.
ex.zh: …一位新崇拜者送来的一束花。

e.en: Flowers are small plants that are grown for their flowers as opposed to trees, shrubs, and vegetables.

ex.en: ...a lawned area surrounded by screening plants and flowers.
ex.zh: …四周环绕着屏障植物和花卉的一块草地。

e.en: When a plant or tree flowers, its flowers appear and open.

ex.en: Several of these rhododendrons will flower this year for the first time.
ex.zh: 这些杜鹃花中有好几株今年将第一次开花。

d: n. 花，开花植物；精华，最好的部分
v. 开花；繁荣，兴旺
【名】 （Flower）（英）弗劳尔（人名）

e.en: If you are grateful for something that someone has given you or done for you, you have warm, friendly feelings towards them and wish to thank them.

ex.en: She was grateful to him for being so good to her.
ex.zh: 她很感激他对她这么好。

e.en: 感激地

ex.en: "That's kind of you, Sally," Claire said gratefully.
ex.zh: “你真好，萨莉”，克莱尔感激地说。

d: adj. 感谢的，感激的；（尤用于书信或正式场合提出请求）感激不尽，请；令人获得快意的，受欢迎的

e.en: a Eurasian plant, Aster linosyris (or Linosyris vulgaris), with clusters of small yellow flowers: family Asteraceae (composites)

d: n. （常作 Goldilocks）金发姑娘，金发女孩（英国童话《金发姑娘和三只熊》中的小女孩）；金凤花的一种（goldilocks aster，菊科植物，学名 Aster linosyris，开黄色小花）
adj. （Goldilocks，作定语）金发姑娘式的，恰到好处、不偏不倚的（如 Goldilocks principle（金发姑娘原则）、Goldilocks zone（宜居带））

e.en: The habitat of an animal or plant is the natural environment in which it normally lives or grows.

ex.en: In its natural habitat, the hibiscus will grow up to 25 ft.
ex.zh: 在其野生环境中，木槿能长25英尺。

d: n. （生态）栖息地，生境；（动植物的）（经）产地（habitat 的复数形式）

e.en: a young animal that has newly emerged from an egg

d: n. 刚孵化的小动物，幼雏
n. 赫布里底群岛（位于英国苏格兰西部）
n. 霍布斯（人名）
adj. 钩状的

e.en: Something or someone that is immature is not yet completely grown or fully developed. 未发育完全的;

ex.en: She is emotionally immature.
ex.zh: 她在情感上不成熟。

e.en: If you describe someone as immature, you are being critical of them because they do not behave in a sensible or responsible way.

ex.en: She's just being childish and immature.
ex.zh: 她真是小孩子气，太冒失了。

d: adj. 发育未全的；（人）幼稚的，不成熟的；粗糙的

e.en: Joint means shared by or belonging to two or more people. 联合的;

ex.en: She and Frank had never got around to opening a joint account.
ex.zh: 她和弗兰克还没能抽出时间开个联名账户。

e.en: 联合地;

ex.en: The Port Authority is an agency jointly run by New York and New Jersey.
ex.zh: 该港务局是纽约和新泽西共管的机构。

e.en: A joint is a part of your body such as your elbow or knee where two bones meet and are able to move together.

ex.en: Her joints ache if she exercises.
ex.zh: 她的关节一运动就疼。

e.en: A joint is the place where two things are fastened or joined together.

ex.en: ...the joint between the inner and outer panels.
ex.zh: …内外嵌板的连接处。

d: n. 关节；连接，接头；（机械）运动副（joint 的复数）

e.en: Your knee is the place where your leg bends.

ex.en: He will receive physical therapy on his damaged left knee.
ex.zh: 他受损的左膝将接受理疗。

e.en: If something or someone is on your knee or on your knees, they are resting or sitting on the upper part of your legs when you are sitting down. (坐着时)

ex.en: He sat with the package on his knees.
ex.zh: 他坐着，包放在大腿上。

e.en: If you are on your knees, your legs are bent and your knees are on the ground.

ex.en: She fell to the ground on her knees and prayed.
ex.zh: 她跪在地上祈祷。

e.en: If you knee someone, you hit them using your knee.

ex.en: Ian kneed him in the groin.
ex.zh: 伊恩用膝盖撞击他的腹股沟。

d: n. 膝盖，膝关节；（裤子的）膝部；（坐下时）大腿朝上的面；膝盖的猛击；（木船上的）肘板，肘材；曲线图的弯曲处，拐点
v. 用膝盖顶（撞）
【名】 （Knee）（英）尼（人名）
adj. 更大的（large 的比较级）；大的；多量的；众多的；大规模的；（服装、食物、日用品等）大型号的

e.en: Larval means concerning insect larvae or in the state of being an insect larva. 幼虫的;

d: adj. 幼虫的，幼虫状态的；潜在的，潜伏的，隐蔽的

e.en: The lifespan of a person, animal, or plant is the period of time for which they live or are normally expected to live. (人或动植物的)

ex.en: A 15-year lifespan is not uncommon for a dog.
ex.zh: 15年的寿命对狗来说并非罕见。

e.en: The lifespan of a product, organization, or idea is the period of time for which it is expected to work properly or to last. (产品、组织或想法的)

ex.en: Most boilers have a lifespan of 15 to 20 years.
ex.zh: 大部分锅炉的使用期限是15到20年。

d: n. （人或动物的）寿命；使用期，有效期

e.en: Loss is the fact of no longer having something or having less of it than before.

ex.en: ...loss of sight.
ex.zh: …失明。

ex.en: ...hair loss.
ex.zh: …脱发。

e.en: Loss of life occurs when people die.

ex.en: ...a terrible loss of human life.
ex.zh: …人员死亡惨重。

e.en: The loss of a relative or friend is their death. (亲人、朋友的)

ex.en: They took the time to talk about the loss of Thomas and how their grief was affecting them.
ex.zh: 他们花时间来谈论托马斯的去世以及悲伤给他们带来的影响。

e.en: Loss is the feeling of sadness you experience when someone or something you like is taken away from you.

ex.en: Talk to others about your feelings of loss and grief.
ex.zh: 和别人说说你失落和悲伤。

d: n. 失去，丧失；亏损；死亡，去世；失落，伤感；（因某人的离去或某物的挪移而造成的）损失；（比赛等的）失败，失利；战斗中死亡（受伤或被俘）的士兵；减少，降低；（进攻推进不成却被逼）后退的距离；损耗
【名】 （Loss）（匈）洛什，（法、德、意）洛斯（人名）

e.en: Management is the control and organizing of a business or other organization. (对企业等组织的)

ex.en: The zoo needed better management rather than more money.
ex.zh: 动物园需要更好的管理而非更多的钱。

ex.en: The dispute is about wages, working conditions, and the management of the mining industry.
ex.zh: 这场争端涉及工资、工作环境和采矿业的管理。

e.en: You can refer to the people who control and organize a business or other organization as the management.

ex.en: The management is doing its best to improve the situation.
ex.zh: 管理层正在尽全力改善局面。

ex.en: We need to get more women into top management.
ex.zh: 我们需要让更多的女性进入高管层。

e.en: Management is the way people control different parts of their lives. (对生活的)

ex.en: ...her management of her professional life.
ex.zh: …她对自己职业生涯的管理。

d: n. 经营，管理，安排；管理人员，管理层；（成功的）处理手段，（有效的）处理能力；治疗，监控；欺骗，欺诈
adv. 全国性地，在全国范围内；就全国而言，以国民立场地；举国一致地
abbr. 自然的（naturalis）
n. （Natur）人名；（阿拉伯）纳图尔

e.en: If you say that it is natural for someone to act in a particular way or for something to happen in that way, you mean that it is reasonable in the circumstances.

ex.en: It is only natural for youngsters to crave the excitement of driving a fast car.
ex.zh: 年轻人渴望开快车的刺激相当自然。

ex.en: It is only natural that he should resent you.
ex.zh: 他会怨恨你是很自然的。

e.en: Natural behaviour is shared by all people or all animals of a particular type and has not been learned. 天生的 (行为)

ex.en: ...the insect's natural instinct to feed.
ex.zh: …昆虫进食的天生本能。

e.en: Someone with a natural ability or skill was born with that ability and did not have to learn it. 天赋的 (才能等)

ex.en: She has a natural ability to understand the motives of others.
ex.zh: 她具备洞察别人动机的天赋。

e.en: If you say that someone is a natural, you mean that they do something very well and very easily.

ex.en: He's a natural with any kind of engine.
ex.zh: 他是发动机方面的天才。

d: adj. 天然的，非人为的；合理的，意料之中的；天生的，本能的；不做作的，真实的；亲生的；私生的；符合是非判断的；自然科学的；本位音的；（织物）原色的，本白色的；（铜管乐器）无键（或孔）的；（与）泛音列音符和间隔（有关）的；（桥牌）（叫牌）实叫的；（基督教神学）物质世界的，非精神的
n. 有天赋的人；适合人选；本位音；白键；（纸牌、掷骰子中）最好的组合；天然鱼饵；白痴
【名】 （Natural）（西）纳图拉尔（人名）

e.en: A bird's nest is the home that it makes to lay its eggs in. (鸟类的)

ex.en: I can see an eagle's nest on the rocks.
ex.zh: 我能看到岩石上的一个鹰巢。

e.en: When a bird nests somewhere, it builds a nest and settles there to lay its eggs.

ex.en: Some species may nest in close proximity to each other.
