e.en: They're is the usual spoken form of "they are." (they are)

ex.en: People eat when they're depressed.
ex.zh: 人们会在沮丧时吃东西。

d: abbr. 他们（是），她们（是），它们（是）：they are 的缩约形式，口语中常用。

e.en: If you make an accusation against someone, you criticize them or express the belief that they have done something wrong.

ex.en: Kim rejects accusations that country music is over-sentimental.
ex.zh: 金姆反驳了那些说乡村音乐过于伤感的指责。

e.en: An accusation is a statement or claim by a witness or someone in authority that a particular person has committed a crime, although this has not yet been proved.

ex.en: ...people who have made public accusations of rape.
ex.zh: …对强奸进行了公开指控的人们。

d: n. 控告，指责，谴责；（尚未证实的被控告的）罪名，罪状

e.en: Your address is the number of the house or apartment and the name of the street and the town where you live or work.

ex.en: The address is 2025 M Street, NW, Washington, DC, 20036.
ex.zh: 地址是华盛顿哥伦比亚特区，华盛顿西北，M街2025号，邮编20036。

e.en: The address of a website is its location on the Internet, for example, http://www.thomson.com.

ex.en: Full details, including the website address to log on to, are at the bottom of this page.
ex.zh: 包括要登陆的网址的完整信息在本页下端。

e.en: If a letter, envelope, or parcel is addressed to you, your name and address have been written on it. 写 (收信人的)

ex.en: Applications should be addressed to: The business affairs editor.
ex.zh: 申请信应该寄给商务编辑。

e.en: If you address a group of people, you give a speech to them.

ex.en: He is due to address a conference on human rights next week.
ex.zh: 他下周要在一个人权会议上发言。

d: v. （address 的现在分词或动名词）在（信封、包裹等）上写收件人姓名和地址；对……讲话，致辞；以（某种称呼或头衔）称呼（某人）；考虑处理，应对，解决（问题）；（高尔夫）就位准备击球
n. （计算机/网络）寻址，定址，编址，即按地址访问

e.en: When someone screams, they make a very loud, high-pitched cry, for example, because they are in pain or are very frightened. (人因痛苦或恐惧而)

ex.en: Women were screaming; some of the houses nearest the bridge were on fire.
ex.zh: 女人们在尖叫；最靠近桥的一些房屋在燃烧。

e.en: Scream is also a noun.

ex.en: Hilda let out a scream.
ex.zh: 希尔达发出了一声尖叫。

e.en: If you scream something, you shout it in a loud, high-pitched voice.

ex.en: "Brigid!" she screamed. "Get up!"
ex.zh: “布里吉德！”她尖声叫道。“起床！”

d: adj. 尖叫的，尖声的；使人惊叹的，极其醒目的；使人捧腹大笑的，极其滑稽可笑的
n. 尖叫，尖叫声
v. 尖叫，尖声喊叫（scream 的现在分词）；大笑，笑得前仰后合（scream 的现在分词）；呼啸着前进，发出尖啸声（scream 的现在分词）；大声疾呼，呼吁，抗议（scream 的现在分词）；告密，揭发（scream 的现在分词）

e.en: People sometimes refer to North America, Central America, and South America collectively as the Americas. 美洲(包括北美、中美和南美)

ex.en: They're found all over the Far East and the Americas.
ex.zh: 它们在远东和美洲都被发现了。

d: n. 美洲

e.en: If you amplify a sound, you make it louder, usually by using electronic equipment. 扩大 (声音)

ex.en: This landscape seemed to trap and amplify sounds.
ex.zh: 这种地形好像能聚拢和扩大声音。

ex.en: The music was amplified with microphones.
ex.zh: 那音乐被麦克风扩大了。

e.en: 扩音

ex.en: ...a voice that needed no amplification.
ex.zh: …一个不需要扩音的嗓门。

e.en: To amplify something means to increase its strength or intensity.

ex.en: The mist had been replaced by a kind of haze that seemed to amplify the heat.
ex.zh: 这薄雾已经被一种热汽代替了，这似乎加重了炎热的程度。

d: v. 放大，增强；详述，展开说明（amplify 的过去式和过去分词；详述义常与 on/upon 连用）
adj. 放大的，增强的；扩充的，展开的

e.en: An announcement is a statement made to the public or to the media that gives information about something that has happened or that will happen.

ex.en: She made her announcement after talks with the president.
ex.zh: 她在与总统的会谈后发布了公告。

e.en: An announcement in a public place, such as a newspaper or the window of a shop, is a short piece of writing telling people about something or asking for something.

ex.en: The Seattle Times publishes brief announcements of religious events every Saturday.
ex.zh: 《西雅图时报》每周六刊登简短的宗教活动通告。

e.en: The announcement of something that has happened is the act of telling people about it.

ex.en: ...the announcement of their engagement.
ex.zh: …他们婚约的宣布。

d: n. 公告；（报纸上的）布告；宣布
n. 安提瓜岛

e.en: An assembly is a large group of people who meet regularly to make decisions or laws for a particular region or country.

ex.en: ...the campaign for the first free election to the National Assembly.
ex.zh: …为首次自由选举入国民议会而进行的运动。

e.en: An assembly is a group of people gathered together for a particular purpose.

ex.en: He waited until complete quiet settled on the assembly.
ex.zh: 他等到集会者完全安静下来。

e.en: When you refer to rights of assembly or restrictions on assembly, you are referring to the legal right that people have to gather together.

ex.en: The U.S. Constitution guarantees free speech, freedom of assembly and equal protection.
ex.zh: 美国宪法保证自由言论、集会自由和平等保护权。

e.en: The assembly of a machine, device, or object is the process of fitting its different parts together.

ex.en: For the rest of the day, he worked on the assembly of an explosive device.
ex.zh: 在那天余下的时间里，他在进行一个爆炸装置的组装。

d: n. 议会，代表大会；集会，集会者；装配，组装；（计算机）汇编

e.en: If you attempt to do something, especially something difficult, you try to do it. 试图 (尤指做困难的事)

ex.en: The only time that we attempted to do something like that was in the city of Philadelphia.
ex.zh: 我们惟一一次试图做那样的事是在费城。

e.en: If you make an attempt to do something, you try to do it, often without success. (常指不成功的)

ex.en: ...a deliberate attempt to destabilize the defence.
ex.zh: …蓄意削弱防御的企图。

e.en: An attempt on someone's life is an attempt to kill them. (杀人)

ex.en: ...an attempt on the life of the former Iranian prime minister.
ex.zh: …刺杀伊朗前总理的企图。

d: v. 尝试，试图，企图：努力去做某事，尤指可能失败的事情（attempt 的现在分词/动名词）。

e.en: A campaigner is a person who campaigns for social or political change.

ex.en: ...anti-war campaigners.
ex.zh: …反战活动家们。

d: n. 活动人士，运动参与者，倡导者；竞选者，候选人；（旧，军事）从军者，出征者（campaigner 的复数）

e.en: (in Old English, Old Norse, etc) the change of a vowel into a diphthong (古英语，古挪威语等的)

d: v. break 的现在分词和动名词，表示打破、破坏、中断、违背等动作，具体含义随搭配而定
n. 破坏；断裂；阻断；霹雳舞，街舞
adj. （波浪）翻卷破碎的，拍岸成浪花的
n. （Beckles）人名；（英）比克尔斯；（西）贝克莱斯
巴布达岛（地名）
adv. 绝对地；断然地；直截了当地

e.en: A circle is a shape consisting of a curved line completely surrounding an area. Every part of the line is the same distance from the centre of the area.

ex.en: The flag was red, with a large white circle in the centre.
ex.zh: 那面旗子是红色的，中间有一个白色的大圆圈。

e.en: A circle of something is a round, flat piece or area of it.

ex.en: Cut out 4 circles of pastry.
ex.zh: 切出4块圆形油酥面饼。

e.en: A circle of objects or people is a group of them arranged in the shape of a circle.

ex.en: ...a circle of gigantic stones.
ex.zh: …一圈巨石。

e.en: You can refer to a group of people as a circle when they meet each other regularly because they are friends or because they belong to the same profession or share the same interests. (相同兴趣、职业等的人形成的)

ex.en: He has a small circle of friends.
ex.zh: 他有一个小小的朋友圈子。

d: n. 圆，圆圈；圆形物；围成一圈的人或物；（相同兴趣、职业等的）圈子，界（常与 in 连用）；循环（circle 的复数）
v. 环绕（circle 的第三人称单数）；盘旋；包围；圈出

e.en: If a piece of writing circulates or is circulated, copies of it are passed around among a group of people. 散发;

ex.en: The document was previously circulated in New York at the United Nations.
ex.zh: 这份文件过去曾在纽约的联合国总部传阅过。

ex.en: Public employees, teachers and liberals are circulating a petition for his recall.
ex.zh: 公务员、教师和自由主义者们正在传签一份请求召回他的请愿书。

e.en: 流传

ex.en: ...an inquiry into the circulation of "unacceptable literature."
ex.zh: …对于“不可接受的文学”的流传所进行的调查。

e.en: If something such as a rumour circulates or is circulated, the people in a place tell it to each other. 散布;

ex.en: Rumours were already beginning to circulate that the project might have to be abandoned.
ex.zh: 有关这个项目可能被迫放弃的流言已经开始在四处传播。

e.en: When something circulates, it moves easily and freely within a closed place or system.

ex.en: ...a virus which circulates via the bloodstream and causes ill health in a variety of organs.
ex.zh: …一种通过血流在体内循环而导致许多器官病变的病毒。

d: v. （液体或气体）环流，循环；传播，流传；传阅，传送；来往应酬，周旋

e.en: Caribbean Community and Common Market
e.zh: 加勒比共同体和共同市场

d: abbr. 加勒比共同市场（Caribbean Community and Common Market）

e.en: people not of noble birth viewed as forming a political order

d: n. 平民百姓，非贵族民众（常与 the 连用，作复数）；（常大写 the Commons）下议院（英国、加拿大等国议会的下院，House of Commons 的简称）；公地，共有土地（社区或公众共用的开阔地，可放牧或休闲，单数形式也作 common）；公共食堂或公共活动区（学校或学院中供师生集体用餐或活动的场所）；共享资源，公共资源（尤用于 the tragedy of the commons、global commons 等搭配）

e.en: Danger is the possibility that someone may be harmed or killed.

ex.en: My friends endured tremendous danger in order to help me.
ex.zh: 为了帮助我，我的朋友们经历了巨大的危险。

e.en: A danger is something or someone that can hurt or harm you. 威胁;

ex.en: ...the dangers of smoking.
ex.zh: …吸烟的危害。

e.en: If there is a danger that something unpleasant will happen, it is possible that it will happen. 危险;

ex.en: There is a real danger that some people will no longer be able to afford insurance.
ex.zh: 一个真正的风险是有些人将再也负担不起保险费。

ex.en: There was no danger that any of these groups would be elected to power.
ex.zh: 丝毫不存在这些团体胜选掌权的危险。

e.en: If someone who has been seriously ill is out of danger, they are still ill, but they are not expected to die.

ex.en: There is some risk of the lung collapsing again, but he is out of danger.
ex.zh: 肺部的确存在再次衰竭的危险，但他脱离危险期了。

d: n. 危险，风险；威胁，危险因素；（不愉快之事发生的）可能性，风险
【名】 （Danger）（法）当热（人名）

e.en: If you say that you need or have a great deal of or a good deal of a particular thing, you are emphasizing that you need or have a lot of it.

ex.en: ...a great deal of money.
ex.zh: …许多钱。

e.en: Deal is also an adverb.

ex.en: As a relationship becomes more established, it also becomes a good deal more complex.
ex.zh: 当一段关系固定下来以后，它也会变得复杂得多。

e.en: Deal is also a pronoun.

ex.en: Although he had never met Geoffrey Hardcastle, he knew a good deal about him.
ex.zh: 尽管他从未见过杰弗里·哈德卡斯尔，他还是十分了解他。

e.en: If you make a deal, do a deal, or cut a deal, you complete an agreement or an arrangement with someone, especially in business. 达成协议;

ex.en: He made a deal to testify against the others and wasn't charged.
ex.zh: 他达成了协议出庭指证别人，因而未获指控。

ex.en: Japan will have to do a deal with the U.S. on rice imports.
ex.zh: 日本将不得不就水稻进口问题和美国达成协议。

d: n. 交往，交易；经营方式

e.en: Developmental means relating to the development of someone or something. 发展的;

ex.en: ...the emotional, educational, and developmental needs of the child.
ex.zh: ...儿童在感情、教育和成长上的需求。

d: adj. 发展的，生长的；促使成长的，起改进作用的

e.en: A crossroads is a place where two roads meet and cross each other.

ex.en: Turn right at the first crossroads.
ex.zh: 在第一个十字路口向右转。

e.en: If you say that something is at a crossroads, you mean that it has reached a very important stage in its development where it could go one way or another.

ex.en: The company was clearly at a crossroads.
ex.zh: 这个公司显然正处于紧要关头。

d: n. 十字路口；交叉路口；聚会的中心地点

e.en: If two or more things differ, they are unlike each other in some way.

ex.en: The story he told police differed from the one he told his mother.
ex.zh: 他告诉警察的话和告诉他母亲的不同。

e.en: If people differ about something, they do not agree with each other about it.

ex.en: The two leaders had differed on the issue of sanctions.
ex.zh: 就制裁问题两位领导持不同意见。

ex.en: That is where we differ.
ex.zh: 那就是我们的分歧所在。

d: v. 不同于；意见有分歧
【名】 （Differ）（法）迪费（人名）

e.en: Discourse is spoken or written communication between people, especially serious discussion of a particular subject. (某专题的)

ex.en: ...a tradition of political discourse.
ex.zh: …一个政治对话的传统。

d: n. 演讲，论述；谈话，交流；话语，语篇
v. 高谈阔论，论述；交谈；说出；演奏出

e.en: A duck is a common water bird with short legs, a short neck, and a large flat beak.

ex.en: Chickens and ducks scratch around the outbuildings.
ex.zh: 鸡鸭在外屋四周挖扒。

e.en: Duck is the flesh of this bird when it is eaten as food.

ex.en: ...honey roasted duck.
ex.zh: …蜜汁烤鸭。

e.en: a score of nothing by a batsman
a heavy cotton fabric of plain weave, used for clothing, tents, etc

d: n. 鸭子；鸭肉；母鸭；（板球）零分；幸运儿，不寻常的人；宝贝儿，亲爱的；突然的低头；帆布，粗布
v. 逃避，回避；躲避；（开玩笑地）把（人）按入水中；迅速移动；（桥牌）放掉；（迅速）低头，弯身
【名】 （Duck）（德、葡、匈）杜克（人名）

e.en: Everybody means the same as .

d: pron. 每个人，人人

e.en: If something is false, it is incorrect, untrue, or mistaken.

ex.en: It was quite clear the president was being given false information by those around him.
ex.zh: 很明显，总统身边的那些人正给总统提供着错误信息。

ex.en: You do not know whether what you're told is true or false.
ex.zh: 你不知道别人告诉你的是真的还是假的。

e.en: 错误地

ex.en: ...a man who is falsely accused of a crime.
ex.zh: …一名被错误地指控犯有一个罪行的男子。

e.en: You use false to describe objects which are artificial but which are intended to look like the real thing or to be used instead of the real thing.

ex.en: ...a set of false teeth.
ex.zh: …一副假牙。

e.en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as false, you are criticizing them for being insincere or for hiding their real feelings.

ex.en: "Thank you," she said with false enthusiasm.
ex.zh: “谢谢你，” 她故作热情地说。

d: adj. 错误的，不真实的；伪造的；人造的；站不住脚的，全无根据的；不真诚的；不忠诚的；外表上与……相似的；非法的；妄动的
adv. 欺诈地

e.en: You use finally to suggest that something happens after a long period of time, usually later than you wanted or expected it to happen.

ex.en: The food finally arrived at the end of last week and distribution began.
ex.zh: 食物终于在上周末抵达并开始分发。

e.en: You use finally to indicate that something is last in a series of actions or events.

ex.en: The action slips from comedy to melodrama and finally to tragedy.
ex.zh: 剧情由喜剧慢慢发展成闹剧，最后又演变为悲剧。

d: adv. 终于；总之，最后；决定性地，不可变更地
abbr. 英国外交、联邦和发展事务部（Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office）

e.en: If you foresee something, you expect and believe that it will happen.

ex.en: He did not foresee any problems.
ex.zh: 他没有预见到任何问题。

d: v. 预见，预知（foresee 的过去分词）
adj. 预知的，预见到的

e.en: If people gather somewhere, or if someone gathers people somewhere, they come together in a group.

ex.en: In the evenings, we gathered around the fireplace and talked.
ex.zh: 晚上，我们聚在壁炉旁聊天。

e.en: If you gather things, you collect them together so that you can use them.

ex.en: I suggest we gather enough firewood to last the night.
ex.zh: 我建议我们捡拾足够的木柴来度过这个夜晚。

e.en: Gather up means the same as .

ex.en: When Steinberg had gathered up his papers, he went out.
ex.zh: 斯坦伯格收好文件后，走了出去。

e.en: If you gather information or evidence, you collect it, especially over a period of time and after a lot of hard work.

ex.en: ...a private detective using a hidden tape recorder to gather information.
ex.zh: …一名用一部暗藏的磁带录音机来搜集信息的私家侦探。

d: vt.&vi. 聚集，召集；收集，采集；认为，推断；增加（速度、力量等）；给……打褶；收紧，拉近
【名】 （Gather）（德）加特（人名）

e.en: Something that is historic is important in history, or likely to be considered important at some time in the future.

ex.en: ...the historic changes in Eastern Europe.
ex.zh: …东欧有历史性意义的变化。

d: adj. 历史上重要的；过去的，与历史（或过去）有关的；（时态）历史的

e.en: a light thin leno-weave fabric of silk, wool, rayon, or nylon, used esp for dresses
a syrup made from pomegranate juice, used as a sweetening and colouring agent in various drinks

d: n. 格林纳丁斯群岛（位于西印度洋）

e.en: If you talk about the indignity of doing something, you mean that it makes you feel embarrassed or unimportant.

ex.en: Later, he suffered the indignity of having to flee angry protesters.
ex.zh: 后来，他因为不得不逃离愤怒的抗议者而蒙受羞辱。

d: n. 侮辱，羞辱，轻蔑；有伤尊严的举动，无礼行为

e.en: Someone who is informed knows about a subject or what is happening in the world. 见多识广的;

ex.en: Informed people know the company is shaky.
ex.zh: 了解情况的人知道该公司状况不稳定。

e.en: When journalists talk about informed sources, they mean people who are likely to give correct information because of their private or special knowledge. 有根据的 (消息来源)

ex.en: According to informed sources, those taken into custody include at least one major-general.
ex.zh: 据可靠消息来源，被拘捕者中至少包括一名陆军少将。

e.en: An informed guess or decision is one that likely to be good, because it is based on definite knowledge or information. 明智的 (猜测或决定)

ex.en: Science is now enabling us to make more informed choices about how we use common drugs.
ex.zh: 科学现在使得我们能够对如何使用常用药品做出更明智的选择。

d: adj. 有知识的，了解情况的；有根据的，可靠的；明智的，有见识的
v. 通知，告知；告发，检举（inform on）；了解，熟悉（inform 的过去式和过去分词形式）

e.en: The infrastructure of a country, society, or organization consists of the basic facilities such as transportation, communications, power supplies, and buildings, which enable it to function. (国家、社会、组织赖以行使职能的)

ex.en: ...improvements in the country's infrastructure.
ex.zh: …国家基础设施的改善。

d: n. 下面结构；永久性军事设施；基础设施，基础建设

e.en: If you are involved in a situation or activity, you are taking part in it or have a strong connection with it. 参与的;

ex.en: If she were involved in business, she would make a strong chief executive.
ex.zh: 如果她经商的话，将会是一位有力的首席执行官。

e.en: If you are involved in something, you give a lot of time, effort, or attention to it.

ex.en: The family was deeply involved in Jewish culture.
ex.zh: 这家人醉心于犹太文化。

e.en: The things involved in something such as a job or system are the necessary parts or consequences of it.

ex.en: We believe the time and hard work involved in completing such an assignment are worthwhile.
ex.zh: 我们相信为完成这项任务所需要投入的时间和付出的努力是值得的。

e.en: If a situation or activity is involved, it has a lot of different parts or aspects, often making it difficult to understand, explain, or do.

ex.en: The operations can be quite involved, requiring many procedures in order to restructure the anatomy.
ex.zh: 手术可能会十分复杂，需要许多步骤来重建结构。

d: adj. 复杂的；与……关系密切的；专心于……的，忙于……的；卷入的，参与的
v. 牵涉，包含（involve 的过去式和过去分词形式）
n. 希拉里（女子名，男子名）

e.en: Labour is very hard work, usually physical work.

ex.en: ...the labour of hauling the rocks away.
ex.zh: …拖走这些岩石的劳动。

e.en: Someone who labours works hard using their hands.

ex.en: ...he will be labouring 14 hundred metres below ground.
ex.zh: …他将在地下1400米处艰苦劳动。

e.en: If you labour to do something, you do it with difficulty.

ex.en: Scientists laboured for months to unravel the mysteries of Neptune and still remain baffled.
ex.zh: 科学家们为揭开海王星之谜艰难地工作了数月，但依然迷惑不解。

ex.en: We're labouring under an unfair disadvantage.
ex.zh: 我们在不公平的劣势下艰难地工作。

e.en: Labour is used to refer to the workers of a country or industry, considered as a group. (总称)

ex.en: We have a problem of skilled labour.
ex.zh: 我们缺少熟练工。

ex.en: Employers want cheap labour and consumers want cheap houses.
ex.zh: 雇主需要廉价的劳动力，消费者需要便宜的房子。

d: n. 劳动；任务，（一段时间的）工作；劳工，工人，劳动力；分娩，临盆；工会；（英国）工党
v. 劳动，劳作；努力做（困难的事）；费力地行进；误以为，为……所蒙蔽；一再重申，反复说明；耕（地）
adj. 工党的，支持工党的

e.en: An item is one of a collection or list of objects.

ex.en: The most valuable item on show will be a Picasso drawing.
ex.zh: 展览中最有价值的作品将是毕加索的一幅画。

e.en: An item is one of a list of things for someone to do, deal with, or talk about.

ex.en: The other item on the agenda is the tour.
ex.zh: 另一项议程是旅行。

e.en: An item is a report or article in a newspaper or magazine, or on television or radio. (报刊、电视或广播中的)

ex.en: There was an item in the paper about him.
ex.zh: 报纸上有一篇关于他的报道。

e.en: If you say that two people are an item, you mean that they are having a romantic or sexual relationship. (在恋爱或有性关系的)

ex.en: She and Gino were an item.
ex.zh: 她和吉诺曾是一对。

d: n. 项目，条款；一件商品（或物品）；一则，一条（新闻）；（关系亲密的）一对
adv. （用于介绍清单上逐个项目之前）又，此外还有
v. 逐条列出，记下

e.en: House of Lords

d: n. lord 的复数形式：贵族，领主，君主，或对有权势者的尊称“大人、老爷”；引申指头目，巨头；（与 the 连用，常大写）英国议会上议院；（前面与 the 连用）上院议员
v. lord 的第三人称单数：对…作威作福，称王称霸（常用于 lord it over）

e.en: If someone excels in something or excels at it, they are very good at doing it. (在某方面)

ex.en: Mary was a better rider than either of them and she excelled at outdoor sports.
ex.zh: 玛丽比他们俩骑得都好，她擅长户外运动。

ex.en: Academically he began to excel.
ex.zh: 他开始在学术上脱颖而出。

d: v. （excel 的过去式和过去分词）优于，超过，胜过，超越；在某方面擅长，表现出色（常与 in/at 连用）；excel oneself 的过去式和过去分词：超水平发挥，比平时做得更好

e.en: stylish or distinctive; classy 时髦的;

d: adj. （非正式，主要用于美国英语）豪华的，时髦的，上等的
n. （Tony）（美、加、法、澳、英）托尼（人名）

e.en: If you go abroad, you go to a foreign country, usually one that is separated from the country where you live by an ocean or a sea.

ex.en: I would love to go abroad this year, perhaps to the South of France.
ex.zh: 我今年想去国外，可能去法国南部。

ex.en: He will stand in for Mr. Goh when he is abroad.
ex.zh: 当高先生在国外时他将代行其职。

d: adv. 在国外，到国外；在室外，到室外； 广为流传，广为人知；行动自由； 未击中目标，出错
n. 外国

e.en: A farm is an area of land, together with the buildings on it, that is used for growing crops or raising animals, usually in order to sell them.

ex.en: Farms in France are much smaller than those in the United States or even Britain.
ex.zh: 法国的农场比美国甚至英国的都小得多。

e.en: A mink farm or a fish farm, for example, is a place where a particular kind of animal or fish is bred and kept in large quantities in order to be sold.

ex.en: ...trout fresh from a local trout farm.
ex.zh: …来自当地一家鲑鱼养殖场的新鲜鲑鱼。

e.en: If you farm an area of land, you grow crops or keep animals on it. 耕种;

ex.en: They farmed some of the best land in the country.
ex.zh: 他们耕种着该国最好的一些土地。

ex.en: Bease has been farming for 30 years.
ex.zh: 比斯经营农场已有30年。

d: n. 农场，农庄，庄园；养殖场（farm 的复数形式）
v. 耕种，种植，养殖；经营农场（farm 的第三人称单数形式）

e.en: A hill is an area of land that is higher than the land that surrounds it.

ex.en: ...the shady street that led up the hill to the office building.
ex.zh: …通往山上的办公楼的林荫道。

e.en: If you say that someone is over the hill, you are saying rudely that they are old and no longer fit, attractive, or capable of doing useful work.

ex.en: He doesn't take kindly to suggestions that he is over the hill.
ex.zh: 他不爱听别人说他在走下坡路。

d: n. 山丘，小山；（道路的）斜坡；土堆，小堆；国会山
v. 使成堆
【名】 （Hill）（英、德、匈、捷、罗、芬、瑞典）希尔，（法、西）伊尔（人名）

e.en: You use aged followed by a number to say how old someone is.

ex.en: Alan has two children, aged eleven and nine.
ex.zh: 艾伦有两个孩子，岁数为11岁和9岁。

e.en: Aged means very old.

ex.en: She has an aged parent who's capable of being very difficult.
ex.zh: 她有个年迈的、很难伺候的父亲。

e.en: You can refer to all people who are very old as the aged.

ex.en: The American Society on Aging provides resource services to those dealing with the aged.
ex.zh: 美国老年协会为那些处理老年人问题的人提供资源服务。

d: adj. ……岁的；年老的，年迈的；老化的；（马，农畜）超过成熟年龄的
n. 老年人（the aged）
v. 变老，老化；（使）显老；（使）变陈（age 的过去式和过去分词形式）

e.en: A sharp point or edge is very thin and can cut through things very easily. A sharp knife, tool, or other object has a point or edge of this kind.

ex.en: With a sharp knife, make diagonal slashes in the chicken breast.
ex.zh: 用锋利的刀子斜着切开鸡胸脯。

e.en: You can describe a shape or an object as sharp if part of it or one end of it comes to a point or forms an angle.

ex.en: His nose was thin and sharp.
ex.zh: 他的鼻子又细又尖。

e.en: A sharp bend or turn is one that changes direction suddenly. 急剧的 (转弯)

ex.en: I was approaching a fairly sharp bend that swept downhill to the left.
ex.zh: 我那时正接近一个朝山下向左急转的弯道。

e.en: Sharp is also an adverb.

ex.en: Do not cross the bridge but turn sharp left to go down on to the towpath.
ex.zh: 不要过桥，而是向左急转下到纤道上去。

d: n. （sharp 的复数）（音乐）升半音；升半音符号（♯）；（医疗）锐器（如针头、注射器、手术刀片等）；（缝纫）细长尖头缝衣针；专家；骗子；（同形大写形式还指人名/姓氏）夏普斯
v. （sharp 的第三人称单数）把音调调高；升音演奏；使变尖利；（尤指牌戏中）欺骗
n. 持续性，能维持性

e.en: A windmill is a building with long pieces of wood on the outside that turn around as the wind blows and provide energy for a machine that crushes grain. A windmill is also a similar structure that uses the power of the wind to pump water or make electricity. 风车房;

d: n. 风车房，风力磨坊；玩具风车；（用于发电、汲水的）风车；（尤指旧时用于旋翼机上的）风力旋轮，空气旋轮
v. 使（手臂）作风车般转动；（飞机螺旋桨、旋翼或飞机自身）借风力旋转

e.en: Someone's youth is the period of their life during which they are a child, before they are a fully mature adult.

ex.en: In my youth my ambition had been to be an inventor.
ex.zh: 在我年轻时我的抱负曾是当一名发明家。

e.en: Youth is the quality or state of being young.

ex.en: The team is now a good mixture of experience and youth.
ex.zh: 这支队伍现在是经验与年轻的一个良好结合体。

e.en: Journalists often refer to young men as youths, especially when they are reporting that the young men have caused trouble. 年轻人 (尤用于新闻报道中指惹了麻烦的年轻人)

ex.en: A 17-year-old youth was arrested yesterday.
ex.zh: 一个17岁的年轻人昨天被逮捕了。

e.en: The youth are young people considered as a group.

ex.en: He represents the opinions of the youth of today.
ex.zh: 他代表了如今的青年人的意见。

d: n. 青少年时期；早期，初期；小伙子；（总称）青年人；青春，朝气
abbr. 《美国经济评论》（期刊）（American Economic Review）；阴离子交换树脂（anion exchange resin）；（英国金融）年等效利率（annual equivalent rate）；（医学）白蛋白排泄率（albumin excretion rate）

e.en: If you aim for something or aim to do something, you plan or hope to achieve it.

ex.en: He said he would aim for the 100 metre world record at the world championships in August.
ex.zh: 他说他将以在8月举行的世界锦标赛上打破100米世界纪录为目标。

ex.en: Businesses will have to aim at long-term growth.
ex.zh: 企业必须以长期增长为目标。

e.en: If you aim to do something, you decide or want to do it.

ex.en: I didn't aim to get caught.
ex.zh: 我并不想被抓到。

e.en: If your actions or remarks are aimed at a particular person or group, you intend that the person or group should notice them and be influenced by them.

ex.en: His message was aimed at the undecided middle ground of Israeli politics.
ex.zh: 他所传达的信息针对的是以色列政坛中尚未表态的中间派。

e.en: If you aim a weapon or object at something or someone, you point it toward them before firing or throwing it.

ex.en: When he appeared again, he was aiming the rifle at Wade.
ex.zh: 他再次出现时，他正将步枪瞄准维德。

ex.en: ...a missile aimed at the arms factory.
ex.zh: …一枚瞄准了军工厂的导弹。

d: v. 瞄准，对准；旨在，致力于；针对，指向（aim 的过去式和过去分词）

e.en: An award is a prize or certificate that a person is given for doing something well.

ex.en: The Institute's annual award is presented to organizations that are dedicated to democracy and human rights.
ex.zh: 该协会的年度奖授予致力于民主与人权的组织。

e.en: In law, an award is a sum of money that a court decides should be given to someone. (赔偿金等的)

ex.en: ...worker's compensation awards.
ex.zh: …工人的赔偿金裁定额。

e.en: If someone is awarded something such as a prize or an examination mark, it is given to them.

ex.en: She was awarded the prize for both films.
ex.zh: 她因这两部电影而获奖。

e.en: To award something to someone means to decide that it will be given to that person.

ex.en: We have awarded the contract to a New York-based company.
ex.zh: 我们已经把这份合同给了一家总部设在纽约的公司。

d: v. 授予，颁发（常作被动语态，表示“被授予”）；判给，裁定（award 的过去式和过去分词）

e.en: If you befriend someone, especially someone who is lonely or far from home, you make friends with them. 和…交朋友;

ex.en: The film's about an elderly woman and a young nurse who befriends her.
ex.zh: 该电影是关于一名年迈的妇女和一个待她友善的年轻护士的故事。

d: v. 做……的朋友，和……交朋友；友善对待，以朋友态度对待
n. 伯纳德（男子名）；伯纳德或贝尔纳（姓氏）

e.en: Cancer is a serious disease in which cells in a person's body increase rapidly in an uncontrolled way, producing abnormal growths.

ex.en: Her mother died of breast cancer.
ex.zh: 她母亲死于乳腺癌。

ex.en: Jane was just 25 when she learned she had cancer.
ex.zh: 珍妮得知自己患了癌症时才25岁。

d: n. 癌症；痼疾，社会恶习；巨蟹宫，巨蟹座（Cancer）；出生于巨蟹宫时段（即6月22日至7月22日）的人（Cancer）

e.en: Your brother is a boy or a man who has the same parents as you.

ex.en: Oh, so you're Peter's younger brother.
ex.zh: 噢，这么说你是彼得的弟弟。

e.en: You can describe a man as your brother if he belongs to the same race, religion, country, or profession as you, or if he has similar ideas to you. 弟兄 (用于指同一种族、宗教、国家、职业或有相同思想的人)

ex.en: He told reporters he'd come to be with his Latvian brothers.
ex.zh: 他告诉记者他将和他的拉脱维亚弟兄们在一起。

e.en: Brother is a title given to a man who belongs to a religious community such as a monastery.

ex.en: ...Brother Otto.
ex.zh: …奥托修士。

e.en: Brothers is used in the names of some companies and stores.

ex.en: ...the film company Warner Brothers.
ex.zh: 华纳兄弟影业公司

d: n. 兄弟，弟兄（brother 的复数）；哥们儿，同一团体或信念中的男性成员；…兄弟（用于公司、商店等名称）；布拉泽斯（英语姓氏 Brothers 的音译）
巴克韦尔
n. 协调人，统筹者

e.en: If something or someone connects one thing to another, or if one thing connects to another, or if two things connect, the two things are joined together. (某物、某人) 连接 (某物); (一物与另一物)

ex.en: You can connect the speakers to your CD player.
ex.zh: 你可以将这些扬声器与你的激光唱机连接起来。

ex.en: I connected the wires for the transformer.
ex.zh: 我给变压器接上了电线。

e.en: If two things or places connect or if something connects them, they are joined and people or things can pass between them. (两物或两地)

ex.en: ...the long hallway that connects the rooms.
ex.zh: …连接这些房间的长长的过道。

ex.en: A pedestrian bridge now connects the parking garage with the mall.
ex.zh: 现在一座人行桥连通车库和购物中心。

e.en: If one train or plane, for example, connects with another, it arrives at a time which allows passengers to change to the other one in order to continue their trip. (与火车、飞机等)

ex.en: ...a train connecting with a ferry to Ireland.
ex.zh: …一列与通往爱尔兰的渡船联运的火车。

e.en: If a piece of equipment or a place is connected to a source of power or water, it is joined to that source so that it has power or water. 将 (设备、某地与水源、电源等)

ex.en: These appliances should not be connected to power supplies.
ex.zh: 这些装置不应该接通电源。

d: v. （使）连接；（使）相通；使接通（电源、水源等）；与……有关系；把……联系起来；衔接，联运；（使）换乘（飞机或火车）；给……接通电话；产生共鸣，契合；建立良好关系；击中

e.en: Childcare refers to taking care of children, and to the facilities which help parents to do so. 儿童保育;

ex.en: Both partners shared childcare.
ex.zh: 父母双方一同分担照顾孩子的责任。

d: n. 儿童保育，儿童照管
adj. 儿童保育的，托儿服务的，托管的
n. 康斯伯里（英国地名）

e.en: Employment is the fact of having a paid job.

ex.en: She was unable to find employment.
ex.zh: 她没能找到工作。

e.en: Employment is the fact of employing someone.

ex.en: ...the employment of children under nine.
ex.zh: …9岁以下儿童的雇用。

e.en: Employment is the work that is available in a country or area.

ex.en: ...economic policies designed to secure full employment.
ex.zh: …为确保充分就业而制定的经济政策。

d: n. 雇用；使用，利用；工作，就业；就业人数

e.en: If something encompasses particular things, it includes them.

ex.en: His repertoire encompassed everything from Bach to Schoenberg.
ex.zh: 他的表演曲目从巴赫到勋伯格，样样俱全。

e.en: To encompass a place means to completely surround or cover it. 围住;

ex.en: The map shows the rest of the western region, encompassing nine states.
ex.zh: 这地图显示了其余西部区域，覆盖了9个州。

d: v. 包含，包括；包围，环绕；促成，实现

e.en: If someone establishes something such as an organization, a type of activity, or a set of rules, they create it or introduce it in such a way that it is likely to last for a long time. 建立;

ex.en: The UN has established detailed criteria for who should be allowed to vote.
ex.zh: 联合国就谁应当被允许投票确立了详细标准。

e.en: If you establish contact with someone, you start to have contact with them. You can also say that two people, groups, or countries establish contact. 建立 (联系)

ex.en: We had already established contact with the museum.
ex.zh: 我们已经与那个博物馆建立了联系。

e.en: If you establish that something is true, you discover facts that show that it is definitely true.

ex.en: Medical tests established that she was not their own child.
ex.zh: 医学检测证实她不是他们的亲生孩子。

ex.en: It will be essential to establish how the money is being spent.
ex.zh: 搞清这笔钱是如何被花费的将至关重要。

e.en: 被证实了的

ex.en: That link is an established medical fact.
ex.zh: 那种联系是被证实了的医学事实。

d: v. 建立，设立；证实，确定；发现，找出；使被接受，使得到承认；使（故事的角色）真实；（桥牌）（通过出大牌）使（某）花色所剩的牌都能赢
杜利（人名）
甜薯
杜利（地名）
n. （Dooley）人名；（英）杜利

e.en: If someone or something has the quality of excellence, they are extremely good in some way. 优秀;

ex.en: ...the top award for excellence in journalism and the arts.
ex.zh: …新闻与艺术界的最高杰出奖。

d: n. 杰出，卓越；优点，美德
n. 艾塞克斯（英国英格兰东南部的郡）

e.en: (of printer's type) wider than usual for a particular height (活字)阔体的 (See also extended)

d: adj. 扩大的，扩展的，展开的；（材料）发泡的，多孔的；（金属板）网眼的，钢板网状的；（形状）相对宽的；（活字）阔体的
v. 扩大，扩展，膨胀；详述（expand 的过去式和过去分词）

e.en: A federation is a federal country.

ex.en: ...the Russian Federation.
ex.zh: …俄罗斯联邦。

e.en: A federation is a group of societies or other organizations which have joined together, usually because they share a common interest.

ex.en: ...the American Federation of Government Employees.
ex.zh: …美国政府雇员联合会。

d: n. 联邦政府，联邦；联合会；结成联邦（或联盟）

e.en: A fellowship is a group of people that join together for a common purpose or interest.

ex.en: ...the National Schizophrenia Fellowship.
ex.zh: …全国精神分裂协会。

e.en: A fellowship at a university is a post which involves research work.

ex.en: He was offered a research fellowship at Yale.
ex.zh: 他得到了一个耶鲁大学的研究员职位。

e.en: Fellowship is a feeling of friendship that people have when they are talking or doing something together and sharing their experiences.

ex.en: ...a sense of community and fellowship.
ex.zh: …一种社群归属感和友谊感。

d: n. 交情，友谊；（有相似爱好的）团体，协会，联谊会；（高等院校的）研究员； （研究生）奖学金；董事职位，会员资格；（决定奖学金人选的）奖学金评选组；特邀研究员（职位或项目）

e.en: A forum is a place, situation, or group in which people exchange ideas and discuss issues, especially important public issues.

ex.en: Members of the council agreed that was an important forum for discussion.
ex.zh: 理事会成员们一致认为那是一个用于讨论的重要论坛。

d: n. 讨论会；（因特网上的）论坛，讨论区；法院，法庭；（古罗马）公共集会场所

e.en: A friendship is a relationship between two or more friends.

ex.en: Giving advice when it's not called for is the quickest way to end a good friendship.
ex.zh: 在不需要时给予建议是了结一段友谊的最快方式。

ex.en: She struck up a close friendship with Desiree during the week of rehearsals.
ex.zh: 她在那一周的排练中和德西蕾建立起亲密的友谊。

e.en: Friendship is a relationship between two countries in which they help and support each other.

ex.en: The president set the targets for the future to promote friendship with East Europe.
ex.zh: 总统确定了与东欧增进友好关系的未来目标。

e.en: You use friendship to refer in a general way to the state of being friends, or the feelings that friends have for each other.

ex.en: ...a hobby which led to a whole new world of friendship and adventure.
ex.zh: …一个通向友情和冒险的一个全新世界的爱好。

d: n. 友谊，友情；表示友谊的事例（friendship 的复数）

e.en: A garden is a piece of land next to someone's house, with grass and plants growing in it.

ex.en: ...the most beautiful garden on Earth.
ex.zh: …地球上最美的花园。

e.en: A garden is the part of a yard which is used for growing flowers and vegetables. 花园;
If you garden, you do work in your garden such as weeding or planting.

ex.en: Jim gardened at the homes of friends on weekends.
ex.zh: 吉姆每逢周末在朋友们的家里干园艺活。

e.en: 园艺活

ex.en: I have taken up gardening again.
ex.zh: 我又开始干起了园艺活。

d: n. 花园，园子，庭园（garden 的复数形式）；（常用复数）指公共花园、公园或植物园，常用于园名；也用于街道名（…街）
v. 从事园艺，在园中劳作（garden 的第三人称单数形式）

e.en: Green is the colour of grass or leaves.

ex.en: Yellow and green together make a pale green.
ex.zh: 黄色和绿色在一起就成了嫩绿色。

e.en: A place that is green is covered with grass, plants, and trees and not with houses or factories.

ex.en: Every street ends at a park or bit of green space.
ex.zh: 每条街的尽头都是一个公园或一块绿地。

e.en: 翠绿

ex.en: ...the lush greenness of the river valleys.
ex.zh: …河谷的郁郁葱葱。

e.en: Green issues and political movements relate to or are concerned with the protection of the environment.

ex.en: The power of the Green movement in Germany has made that country a leader in the drive to recycle more waste materials.
ex.zh: 德国环保运动的力量已经使该国成了循环利用更多废料运动中的领先者。

d: adj. 绿色的；青春的
n. 绿色；青春
vt. 使……变绿色
vi. 变绿色

e.en: If someone or something inspires you to do something new or unusual, they make you want to do it. 鼓舞;

ex.en: Our challenge is to motivate those voters and inspire them to join our cause.
ex.zh: 我们的艰巨任务是要激励那些投票者并鼓励他们加入我们的事业。

e.en: If someone or something inspires you, they give you new ideas and a strong feeling of enthusiasm. 唤起;

ex.en: In the 1960s, the electric guitar virtuosity of Jimi Hendrix inspired a generation.
ex.zh: 20世纪60年代，吉米·亨德里克斯演奏电吉他的精湛技巧激发了一代人的热情。

e.en: If a book, work of art, or action is inspired by something, that thing is the source of the idea for it. 赋…以灵感;

ex.en: The book was inspired by a real person, namely Tamara de Treaux.
ex.zh: 这本书是受一个叫塔玛拉·德特罗的人启发而写成的。

e.tip: 与形容词结合的复合词
e.en: 受…灵感启示的

ex.en: ...Mediterranean-inspired ceramics in bright yellow and blue.
ex.zh: …源自地中海风格灵感的明黄色和蓝色瓷器。

d: v. 激励，鼓舞；赋予灵感，激发（想法）；使产生（感觉或情感）；引起，导致；吸气，吸入

e.en: A person or animal that is intelligent has the ability to think, understand, and learn things quickly and well.

ex.en: Susan's a very bright and intelligent woman who knows her own mind.
ex.zh: 苏珊是一个非常聪明伶俐而且清楚自己想法的女人。

e.en: 有头脑地

ex.en: They are incapable of thinking intelligently about politics.
ex.zh: 他们在考虑政治问题时缺乏头脑。

e.en: Something that is intelligent can think and understand instead of doing things automatically or by instinct.

ex.en: Intelligent computers will soon be an indispensable diagnostic tool for every doctor.
ex.zh: 智能计算机很快将会成为每位医生必不可少的诊断工具。

d: adj. 聪明的；有智力的；智能的

e.en: When you laugh, you make a sound with your throat while smiling and show that you are happy or amused. People also sometimes laugh when they feel nervous or are being unfriendly.

ex.en: He was about to offer an explanation, but she was beginning to laugh.
ex.zh: 他刚要加以解释，她就开始笑起来了。

ex.en: I just couldn't laugh at his jokes the way I used to.
ex.zh: 我就是不能像以前那样笑他讲的笑话。

e.en: Laugh is also a noun.

ex.en: Lysenko gave a deep rumbling laugh at his own joke.
ex.zh: 李森科对自己讲的笑话报以朗声大笑。

e.en: If people laugh at someone or something, they mock them or make jokes about them.

ex.en: I thought they were laughing at me because I was ugly.
ex.zh: 我想他们在嘲笑我长得丑。

e.en: If you do something for a laugh or for laughs, you do it as a joke or for fun.

ex.en: They were persuaded onstage for a laugh.
ex.zh: 为了开开玩笑，他们被说服登上了台。

d: v. 笑，发笑；嘲笑，不以为然；愉悦地说；用嘲笑使（某人）离开；（特别表示因成功而）处于有利地位
n. 笑，笑声；令人开心的时刻；引人发笑的人或事，笑料

e.en: A hint is a suggestion about something that is made in an indirect way.

ex.en: I'd dropped a hint about having an exhibition of his work up here.
ex.zh: 我暗示要在这里举办一次他的作品展。

e.en: If you take a hint, you understand something that is suggested to you indirectly.

ex.en: "I think I hear the telephone ringing."—"Okay, I can take a hint."
ex.zh: “我想我听见了电话在响。”—“好的，我明白你的意思。”

e.en: If you hint at something, you suggest it in an indirect way.

ex.en: She hinted at the possibility of a treat of some sort.
ex.zh: 她暗示可以找找乐子什么的。

e.en: A hint is a helpful piece of advice, usually about how to do something.

ex.en: Here are some helpful hints to make your journey easier.
ex.zh: 这里是一些有用的建议，可以使你的旅途更舒适。

d: v. hint 的过去式和过去分词：暗示，示意；间接地表示或表达，通常以微妙的方式。

e.en: Irish means belonging or relating to Ireland, or to its people, language, or culture. Irish sometimes refers to the whole of Ireland, and sometimes only to the Republic of Ireland. 爱尔兰的; 爱尔兰人的; 爱尔兰语言的; 爱尔兰文化的;
e.zh: 有时指整个爱尔兰，有时仅指爱尔兰共和国

e.en: The Irish are the people of Ireland, or of the Republic of Ireland. 爱尔兰人;
Irish is a Celtic language spoken by people who live in Ireland, especially in the Republic of Ireland.

d: adj. 爱尔兰的；爱尔兰人的；爱尔兰语的
n. 爱尔兰人（总称）；爱尔兰语
n. 英国一地名，位于英格兰东南部的埃塞克斯郡。

e.en: A merchant is a person who buys or sells goods in large quantities, especially one who imports and exports them.

ex.en: Any knowledgeable wine merchant would be able to advise you.
ex.zh: 任何一位内行的葡萄酒商人都能为你提出建议。

e.en: A merchant is a person who owns or runs a shop, or other business.

ex.en: The family was forced to live on credit from local merchants.
ex.zh: 这家人不得不靠向当地的商家赊账过活。

e.en: Merchant seamen or ships are involved in carrying goods for trade.

ex.en: There's been a big reduction in the size of the merchant fleet in recent years.
ex.zh: 近年来商船队的数量大为缩减。

d: n. 商人，（尤指外贸）批发商；商店老板；对（令人讨厌之事）入迷的人
adj. 海上货运的；商业的，商人的
【名】 （Merchant）（英）麦钱特（人名）
n. （Leef）人名；（英）利夫

e.en: Met is the past tense and past participle of . (meet)

d: v. 遇见（meet 的过去式和过去分词）
n. （Met）人名；（瑞典）梅特

e.en: of, relating to, or denoting a vowel whose articulation lies approximately halfway between high and low, such as e in English bet

d: adj. 中间的；中央的
prep. 在……之中
n. （Mid）人名；（柬）米
n. 马特洛克（英国英格兰中部城镇，德比郡首府）

e.en: A motto is a short sentence or phrase that expresses a rule for sensible behaviour, especially a way of behaving in a particular situation.

ex.en: "Stay true to yourself" has always been his motto.
ex.zh: “忠于自己”一直是他的座右铭。

d: n. 座右铭，格言，警句；格言主题
【名】 （Motto）（英）莫托，（意、西）莫托（人名）

e.en: A country's navy consists of the people it employs to fight at sea, and the ships they use.

ex.en: The operation was organized by the US Navy.
ex.zh: 这次行动是由美国海军组织的。

ex.en: Her own son was also in the navy.
ex.zh: 她自己的儿子也曾在海军里。

e.en: Something that is navy or navy-blue is very dark blue.

ex.en: When I was a fashion editor, I mostly wore white shirts and black or navy trousers.
ex.zh: 当时尚编辑的时候，我大多数时间穿白衬衫和黑色或深蓝色裤子。

d: n. 海军；深蓝色；舰队

e.en: A misunderstanding is a failure to understand something properly, for example a situation or a person's remarks.

ex.en: There has been some misunderstanding of our publishing aims.
ex.zh: 对于我们的出版目的存在一些误解。

e.en: You can refer to a disagreement or slight quarrel as a misunderstanding. 分歧;

ex.en: There was a little misunderstanding with the police and he was arrested.
ex.zh: 由于与警方有些小争执，他被捕了。

d: n. misunderstanding 的复数：误解，误会（对情况或话语的错误理解）；误区（多指某一领域内常见的错误观念或做法）；分歧，争执（因误解引起的小争执）
adj. （常写作 née，用于已婚妇女姓名后，其娘家姓前）娘家姓的，旧姓的；旧称的，原名的（用于已改名的人、组织或事物旧名之前）
n. （Nee）尼（人名）

e.en: A radio or television network is a company or group of companies that broadcast radio or television programmes throughout an area. (广播或电视)

ex.en: Los Angeles-based Univision is a Spanish-language broadcast television network.
ex.zh: 位于洛杉矶的”联合视野”是一家西班牙语的广播电视网。

e.en: A network of people or institutions is a large number of them that have a connection with each other and work together as a system. (由许多人或机构组成的)

ex.en: Distribution of the food is going ahead using a network of local church people and other volunteers.
ex.zh: 食品的分发正在通过当地教会人士和其他志愿者组织网络进行。

e.en: A particular network is a system of things which are connected and which operate together. For example, a computer network consists of a number of computers that are part of the same system.

ex.en: ...a computer network with 154 terminals.
ex.zh: …一个有154台终端的计算机网络。

e.en: A network of lines, roads, veins, or other long thin things is a large number of them which cross each other or meet at many points. (线路、道路、血管等的)

ex.en: ...Strasbourg, with its rambling network of medieval streets.
ex.zh: …斯特拉斯堡，有着修建于中世纪的不规则街网。

d: n. 网络，网状系统；人际关系网，联络网；计算机网络，互联网；广播网，电视网
v. 使（计算机）联网；（尤指工作中）建立关系网，建立人脉；对（电视或广播节目）进行联播

e.en: If you nick something or nick yourself, you accidentally make a small cut in the surface of the object or your skin.

ex.en: When I pulled out of the space, I nicked the rear bumper of the car in front of me.
ex.zh: 我把车从车位开出来时，蹭到了我前面那辆车的后保险杠。

ex.en: A sharp blade is likely to nick the skin and draw blood.
ex.zh: 锋利的刀刃可能会划破皮肤，引起出血。

e.en: A nick is a small cut made in the surface of something, usually in someone's skin.

ex.en: The barbed wire had left only the tiniest nick just below my right eye.
ex.zh: 这带刺的铁丝在我右眼正下方只留下了极小的划痕。

e.en: an alias adopted by a member of a chatroom or forum; nickname 别名;

d: n. 监狱，警察局（the nick）；裂口，刻痕；（尤指健康）状况；（壁球场或室内网球场内侧墙与地面之间的）连接处；别名，绰号
v. 刻痕于，使有缺口；偷；逮捕；讹诈（nick someone for）；迅速去（某地）（nick off）；快步走；（用于体育报道）不当得分
【名】 （Nick）（英、美、菲、瑞、比）尼克（人名）

e.en: To obtain something means to get it or achieve it.

ex.en: Evans was trying to obtain a false passport and other documents.
ex.zh: 埃文斯当时正试图获取假护照和其他文件。

d: v. （尤指经努力）获得；通用，继续存在（obtain 的现在分词）

e.en: If you pat something or someone, you tap them lightly, usually with your hand held flat.

ex.en: "Don't you worry about any of this," she said patting me on the knee.
ex.zh: “不要为这事操什么心了，”她说道，轻轻拍了拍我的膝盖。

ex.en: The landlady patted her hair nervously.
ex.zh: 女房东不安地轻拍着她的头发。

e.en: Pat is also a noun.

ex.en: He gave her an encouraging pat on the shoulder.
ex.zh: 他轻拍她肩膀以示鼓励。

e.en: A pat of butter or something else that is soft is a small lump of it. (奶油等)

ex.en: Terreano put a pat of butter on his plate.
ex.zh: 特里诺把一小块奶油放在他盘子里。

e.en: alone; on one's own

d: v. 轻拍（以示喜爱、赞同或安慰）；轻拍（以引起注意或检查安放好的物品）；爱抚（狗或马等动物）；轻拍抚平，轻拍成形；拍干
n. （表示友善的）轻拍；小块（黄油等）
adj. （回答或解释）脱口而出的，敷衍的
adv. 记得一清二楚地；及时地，适时地

e.en: The placement of something or someone is the act of putting them in a particular place or position. (物的) 安放; (人的)

ex.en: The treatment involves the placement of twenty-two electrodes in the inner ear.
ex.zh: 治疗包括在内耳安放22个电极。

e.en: The placement of someone in a job, home, or school is the act or process of finding them a job, home, or school. (对某人工作、家庭或学校的)

ex.en: The children were waiting for placement in a foster care home.
ex.zh: 孩子们正在等待被安置到寄养家庭里。

e.en: If someone gets a placement, they get a job for a short period of time to gain experience.

ex.en: He spent a year studying Japanese in Tokyo, followed by a six-month work placement with the Japanese government.
ex.zh: 他花了1年时间在东京学日语，接着是在日本政府6个月的实习工作。

d: n. 布置，摆放；（某人的）安置，安顿；实习工作；收容所，安置所；定位球

e.en: If you feel proud, you feel pleased about something good that you possess or have done, or about something good that a person close to you has done.

ex.en: I felt proud of his efforts.
ex.zh: 我为他的努力感到自豪。

ex.en: They are proud that she is doing well at school.
ex.zh: 他们为她在学校功课好而自豪。

e.en: 自豪地

ex.en: "That's the first part finished," he said proudly.
ex.zh: “那是完成的第一部分，”他自豪地说。

e.en: Your proudest moments or achievements are the ones that you are most proud of.

ex.en: This must have been one of the proudest moments of his busy and hard-working life.
ex.zh: 在他忙碌、勤奋的一生中，这可能是他最自豪的时刻之一。

e.en: Someone who is proud has respect for themselves and does not want to lose the respect that other people have for them.

ex.en: He was too proud to ask his family for help and support.
ex.zh: 他自尊心太高，不肯请求家里人的帮助和支持。

d: adj. 自豪的，得意的；令人自豪的；傲慢的，自负的；自尊的，自重的；秀丽的，壮观的；凸出的，隆起的；（肌肉）愈合伤口四周赘生的；（动物）有力量的，精力充沛的
【名】 （Proud）（英）普劳德（人名）

e.en: The practical aspects of something involve real situations and events, rather than just ideas and theories.

ex.en: ...practical suggestions on how to increase the fibre in your daily diet.
ex.zh: …有关如何增加日常饮食中的纤维素的实际建议。

e.en: You describe people as practical when they make sensible decisions and deal effectively with problems.

ex.en: You were always so practical, Maria.
ex.zh: 你总是那么务实，玛丽亚。

ex.en: How could she be so practical when he'd just told her something so shattering?
ex.zh: 他刚对她讲了那么令人震惊的事情，她怎么还能这么务实？

e.en: Practical ideas and methods are likely to be effective or successful in a real situation. (主意、方法)

ex.en: Although the causes of cancer are being uncovered, we do not yet have any practical way to prevent it.
ex.zh: 尽管癌症的病因正被揭开，但我们还没有任何预防它的有效的方法。

e.en: You can describe clothes and things in your house as practical when they are suitable for a particular purpose rather than just being fashionable or attractive. (衣物等)

ex.en: ...lightweight, practical clothes.
ex.zh: …质轻、实用的服装。

d: adj. 真实的，实际的；（计划、方法等）切实有效的，切实可行的；（人）明智的，务实的；合适的，适用的；心灵手巧的，善于制作（或修补）的；几乎完全的，实际上的
n. （科学、烹饪等的）实践课，实用知识考试

e.en: Your qualifications are the official documents or titles you have that show your level of education and training. 资格;

ex.en: "Do you have any qualifications?"—"Yes, I'm certified to teach high school."
ex.zh: “你有资格吗？”—“有，我有资格教高中。”

e.en: Qualification is the act of passing the examinations you need to work in a particular profession.

ex.en: She has met the minimum educational requirements for qualification.
ex.zh: 她已达到了资格取得所需的最低教育水准。

e.en: The qualifications you need for an activity or task are the qualities and skills that you need to be able to do it. 素质;

ex.en: Responsibility and reliability are necessary qualifications, as well as a friendly and outgoing personality.
ex.zh: 责任感和可靠性是必需的素质，友善和外向的性格也必不可少。

e.en: A qualification is a detail or explanation that you add to a statement to make it less strong or less general.

ex.en: The empirical evidence considered here is subject to many qualifications.
ex.zh: 这里所考虑的经验证据有许多限制条件。

d: n. （通过考试或学习课程取得的）资格，学历；（胜任某一工作或职位所需的）资历，技能条件；获得资格，达到标准；先决条件，正式要求；限制，限定性条件；（语法）（尤指对名词等的）限定，修饰

e.en: Someone or something that is quick moves or does things with great speed. 快的;

ex.en: You'll have to be quick. The flight leaves in about three hours.
ex.zh: 你得快点了，那个航班大约3小时后就起飞了。

e.en: 快地;

ex.en: Cussane worked quickly and methodically.
ex.zh: 丘萨恩干得快而且有条不紊。

e.en: Quicker is sometimes used to mean "at a greater speed," and quickest to mean "at the greatest speed." Quick is sometimes used to mean "with great speed." Some people consider this to be non-standard. 有时分别用(quick)、(quicker)和(quickest)
e.zh: 表示“以很快的速度”、“以更快的速度”和“以最快的速度”，但有人认为此用法并不规范

ex.en: Warm the sugar slightly first to make it dissolve quicker.
ex.zh: 首先把糖微微加热让它更快地溶化。

e.en: Something that is quick takes or lasts only a short time.

ex.en: He took one last quick look around the room.
ex.zh: 他朝房间匆匆扫了最后一眼。

d: adj. 迅速的，快的；持续时间很短的，短暂的；敏捷的，脑子反应快的；马上的，即刻的；性情急躁的，容易发怒的
adv.  以很快的速度；迅速发生地，很快发生地
n. （指甲下的）活肉（the quick）；要害，核心（the quick）；活着的人们（the quick）；（板球）快投手
int. 快，快点

e.en: Ran is the past tense of run. (run)

d: v. 跑（run 的过去式）
n. （Ran）人名音译：拉恩（俄、瑞典、塞）；兰（柬埔寨）

e.en: To have a reputation for something means to be known or remembered for it.

ex.en: Alice Munro has a reputation for being a very depressing writer.
ex.zh: 艾丽斯•门罗有文风抑郁的名声。

e.en: Something's or someone's reputation is the opinion that people have about how good they are. If they have a good reputation, people think they are good.

ex.en: This college has a good academic reputation.
ex.zh: 这所大学拥有良好的学术声誉。

e.en: If you know someone by reputation, you have never met them but you have heard of their reputation.

ex.en: She was by reputation a good organizer.
ex.zh: 久闻她是个出色的组织者。

d: n. 名誉，名声

e.en: A rep is a person whose job is to sell a company's products or services, especially by travelling around and visiting other companies. Rep is short for .

ex.en: I'd been working as a sales rep for a photographic company.
ex.zh: 我一直在担任一家摄影公司的销售代表。

e.en: A rep is a person who acts as a representative for a group of people, usually a group of people who work together.

ex.en: Contact the health and safety rep at your union.
ex.zh: 请联系你们工会的健康安全代表。

e.en: repertory company
reputation

d: n. 棱纹平布；雷普（物体伦琴当量）
abbr. 代表（representative）；名声（reputation）

e.en: To reshape something means to change its structure or organization. 改变;

ex.en: If they succeed, then they will have reshaped the political and economic map of the world.
ex.zh: 如果他们获得成功，他们将会改变世界的政治和经济格局。

d: vt. 改造，重塑（改变事物的结构、组织或性质）；使重新成形，再成形；（计算机）改变（数组或矩阵的）维数或形状

e.en: To retain something means to continue to have that thing.

ex.en: The interior of the shop still retains a nineteenth-century atmosphere.
ex.zh: 那家商店内部依然保持着19世纪的格调。

d: adj. 保留的，保持的；（会计）留存的，未分配的（如 retained earnings 留存收益）
v. 保留，保存（retain 的过去式和过去分词）

e.en: A retired person is an older person who has left his or her job and has usually stopped working completely.

ex.en: ...a seventy-three-year-old retired teacher from Florida.
ex.zh: …一位来自佛罗里达的73岁的退休教师。

d: adj. 退休的，退役的；（生活方式）隐居的，退隐的；（人）沉默寡言的，不好交际的；（地方）僻静的，隐蔽的
v. 退休，退役；（因伤）退赛；撤退（retire 的过去式和过去分词形式）
vt. （英国英语拼写；亦作 recognize）认出，辨认出；识别，辨别；承认，认可；认识到，意识到

e.en: Your sister is a girl or woman who has the same parents as you. 姐;

ex.en: His sister Sarah helped him.
ex.zh: 他姐姐萨拉帮助了他。

ex.en: ...Vanessa Bell, the sister of Virginia Woolf.
ex.zh: …弗吉尼亚·伍尔夫的姐姐瓦内莎·贝尔。

e.en: Sister is a title given to a woman who belongs to a religious community.

ex.en: Sister Francesca entered the chapel.
ex.zh: 弗朗西丝卡修女走进小教堂。

e.en: You can describe a woman as your sister if you feel a connection with her, for example, because she belongs to the same race, religion, country, or profession. 姐妹 (对同种族、宗教、国家，或职业女性的亲切说法);

ex.en: Modern woman has been freed from many of the duties that befell her sisters in times past.
ex.zh: 现代女性已从旧时代姐妹们肩负的许多责任中解放出来了。

e.en: You can use sister to describe something that is of the same type or is connected in some way to another thing you have mentioned. For example, if a company has a sister company, they are connected. 同类型的;

ex.en: ...the International Monetary Fund and its sister organization, the World Bank.
ex.zh: …国际货币基金组织和它的姐妹机构，世界银行。

d: n. 姐姐，妹妹；（称志同道合者）姐妹；（女权运动中的）姐妹；姊妹，大姐，妹妹（妇女对其他妇女表示友好和支持时的用语）；姐妹，大姐，妹子（用作女性间的称呼）；大姐，小妹（美国黑人妇女之间使用的称呼）；修女，女教友（Sister）；护士（长）（Sister）；（美国大学）女生联谊会会员；（尤指组织之间的）姐妹（关系）
adj. 同类的，同质的，如同姐妹的

e.en: The sale of goods is the act of selling them for money.

ex.en: Efforts were made to limit the sale of alcohol.
ex.zh: 做出努力来限制酒的销售。

ex.en: ...a proposed arms sale to Saudi Arabia.
ex.zh: …拟议中对沙特阿拉伯的武器销售。

e.en: The sales of a product are the quantity of it that is sold.

ex.en: The newspaper has sales of 1.72 million.
ex.zh: 该报有172万份的销售量。

ex.en: ...the huge Christmas sales of computer games.
ex.zh: …电脑游戏在圣诞节的巨额销售量。

e.en: The part of a company that deals with sales deals with selling the company's products.

ex.en: Until 1983 he worked in sales and marketing.
ex.zh: 到1983年为止他一直供职于市场营销部。

e.en: A sale is an occasion when a shop sells things at less than their normal price.

ex.en: ...a pair of jeans bought half-price in a sale.
ex.zh: …一条减价时半价买的牛仔裤。

d: adj. （多用作定语）销售的，售货的，有关销售的
n. 销售（sale 的复数）；销售量；销售额；（常不带冠词）销售部门，销售工作；促销，减价出售（常作 the sales）；（Sales）人名：萨莱斯（意、西、葡），萨勒（法），塞尔斯（英）

e.en: Sociable people are friendly and enjoy talking to other people. 友善的;

ex.en: She was, and remained, extremely sociable, enjoying dancing, golf, tennis, skating, and bicycling.
ex.zh: 她以前是，现在依然是极其好交际，喜欢跳舞、打高尔夫、打网球、滑冰和骑自行车。

d: adj. 好交际的，合群的，友善的；（地方，场合，活动）气氛友好的
n. （非正式的）社交聚会，交谊会；座位面对面的敞篷马车；并肩双座的三轮车；S 形的双人坐椅

e.en: You use space to refer to an area that is empty or available. The area can be any size. For example, you can refer to a large area outside as a large open space or to a small area between two objects as a small space. 空间;

ex.en: ...cutting down yet more trees to make space for houses.
ex.zh: …砍掉更多的树以腾出空间来盖房屋。

ex.en: I had plenty of space to write and sew.
ex.zh: 我有足够的空间来写作和缝纫。

e.en: A particular kind of space is the area that is available for a particular activity or for putting a particular kind of thing in.

ex.en: ...the high cost of office space.
ex.zh: …办公场所的高额费用。

ex.en: You don't want your living space to look like a bedroom.
ex.zh: 你不会希望你的起居室看上去像一间卧室。

e.en: If a place gives a feeling of space, it gives an impression of being large and open.

ex.en: Large paintings can enhance the feeling of space in small rooms.
ex.zh: 大幅画作能增加小房间的宽敞感。

e.en: If you give someone space to think about something or to develop as a person, you allow them the time and freedom to do this.

ex.en: You need space to think everything over.
ex.zh: 你需要留有余地来仔细考虑一切。

d: n. 空间，空地，空隙；场所，区域（供特定用途）；（计算机/印刷）空格，空白字符
v. 把……分隔开，留间隔（space 的第三人称单数）
n. 翻筋斗，翻跟头（somersault 的变体拼写）；萨默塞特郡（Somerset，英格兰西南部一郡）；萨默塞特（Somerset，英语人名）；有衬垫的马鞍（旧义，供独腿者乘坐）
vi. 翻筋斗，翻跟头（somersault 的变体拼写）

e.en: A spark is a tiny bright piece of burning material that flies up from something that is burning.

ex.en: The fire gradually got bigger and bigger. Sparks flew off in all directions.
ex.zh: 火势逐渐变得越来越大。火花四处飞溅。

e.en: A spark is a flash of light caused by electricity. It often makes a loud sound.

ex.en: He passed an electric spark through a mixture of gases.
ex.zh: 他使一束电火花穿过一团气体混合物。

e.en: If something sparks, sparks of fire or light come from it.

ex.en: The wires were sparking above me.
ex.zh: 电线正在我头顶上方冒火花。

e.en: If a burning object or electricity sparks a fire, it causes a fire. 引发 (一场火)

ex.en: A dropped cigarette may have sparked the fire.
ex.zh: 一支丢弃的香烟可能引发了这场火灾。

d: v. 引发，触发，激起；发出火花，产生电火花；点燃（spark 的过去式和过去分词）

e.en: Storytelling is the activity of telling or writing stories. 讲故事;

ex.en: The programme is 90 minutes of dynamic Indian folk dance, live music, and storytelling.
ex.zh: 该节目为90 分钟，由动感印度民间舞蹈、现场音乐表演和说书组成。

d: n. 讲故事，说故事，叙事；（较少见）说谎话
adj. 讲故事的，用于讲故事的；（较少见）说谎的

e.en: Spent is the past tense and past participle of . (spend)

d: adj. 用过已废的，失效的；筋疲力尽的
v. 用，花（钱）；花费，度过（一段时间）；用尽，耗尽（spend 的过去式和过去分词形式）

e.en: A stranger is someone you have never met before.

ex.en: Telling a complete stranger about your life is difficult.
ex.zh: 向一位完全陌生的人讲述自己的生活是困难的。

e.en: If two people are strangers, they do not know each other.

ex.en: The women knew nothing of the dead girl. They were strangers.
ex.zh: 这些妇女对那个死去的女孩一无所知。她们互不相识。

e.en: If you are a stranger to something, you have had no experience of it or do not understand it.

ex.en: He is no stranger to controversy.
ex.zh: 他对争议一点都不陌生。

d: n. 陌生人；外地人，外来者，新来者；互不相识者；对…不熟悉的人，门外汉，生手（stranger 的复数形式）

e.en: A supervisor is a person who supervises activities or people, especially workers or students. 监督员;

ex.en: ...a full-time job as a supervisor at a factory.
ex.zh: …在一家工厂担任监督员的一项全职工作。

d: n. 监督者，管理者；（英国大学里负责学生研究工作的）指导教师；镇长，县长

e.en: A sum of money is an amount of money. (一) 笔 (钱)

ex.en: Large sums of money were lost.
ex.zh: 大笔大笔的钱损失了。

e.en: In mathematics, the sum of two or more numbers is the number that is obtained when they are added together. (数字的)

ex.en: The sum of all the angles of a triangle is 180 degrees.
ex.zh: 一个三角形的所有角度之和是180度。

e.en: The sum of something is all of it. You often use sum in this way to indicate that you are disappointed because the extent of something is rather small, or because it is not very good.

ex.en: To date, the sum of my gardening experience had been futile efforts to rid the flower beds of grass.
ex.zh: 迄今为止，我全部的园艺经验就是给花圃徒劳地除草。

e.en: A sum is a simple calculation in arithmetic.

d: n. （sum 的复数形式）金额，款项；算术题，简单运算；（数）总数，总和
vt. （sum 的第三人称单数形式）概括，总结；计算……的总和
vi. （sum 的第三人称单数形式）共计，合计为

e.en: If one thing is a testament to another, it shows that the other thing exists or is true.

ex.en: For him to win the game like that is a testament to his perseverance.
ex.zh: 他能赢得那样的比赛证明了他的毅力。

e.en: Someone's last will and testament is the most recent will that they have made, especially the last will that they make before they die.

d: n. 证明，证据；遗嘱，遗言；（人与上帝间的）圣约；（基督教的）圣约书（Testament）

e.en: If you are thoughtful, you are quiet and serious because you are thinking about something.

ex.en: Nancy, who had been thoughtful for some time, suddenly spoke.
ex.zh: 南希沉思半晌后，突然开口说话。

e.en: 沉思地

ex.en: Daniel nodded thoughtfully.
ex.zh: 丹尼尔若有所思地点点头。

e.en: If you describe someone as thoughtful, you approve of them because they remember what other people want, need, or feel, and try not to upset them.

ex.en: ...a thoughtful and caring man.
ex.zh: …一个考虑周到、关心体贴的男人。

e.en: 考虑周到地

ex.en: ...the bottle of wine he had thoughtfully purchased for the celebrations.
ex.zh: …他为庆祝活动特地购买的这瓶葡萄酒。

d: adj. 体贴入微的，考虑周到的；沉思的，思考的；缜密思考过的，深思熟虑的
adv. 完全地，整个地；对极了，太对了

e.en: A travelling actor or musician, for example, is one who travels around an area or country performing in different places.

ex.en: ...travelling entertainers.
ex.zh: ...巡回演出的艺人们。

d: adj. 巡回的，巡演的；旅行用的
n. 旅行；（篮球比赛中的）走步
v. （尤指长途）旅行；走动，移动；（以某速度、朝某方向或在某距离内）行进（travel 的现在分词）

e.en: If a person or living thing survives in a dangerous situation such as an accident or an illness, they do not die.

ex.en: ...the sequence of events that left the eight pupils battling to survive in icy seas for over four hours.
ex.zh: …使4名小学生在冰冷的海洋中挣扎求生超过4个小时的一连串事件。

ex.en: Those organisms that are most suited to the environment will be those that will survive.
ex.zh: 那些最适应环境的生物将是那些存活下来的。

e.en: If you survive in difficult circumstances, you manage to live or continue in spite of them and do not let them affect you very much.

ex.en: On my first day here I thought, "Ooh, how will I survive?"
ex.zh: 在这儿的第一天我想：“噢，我该怎么挺过去呀？”

ex.en: ...people who are struggling to survive without jobs.
ex.zh: …挣扎着以挺过失业的人们。

e.en: If something survives, it continues to exist even after being in a dangerous situation or existing for a long time.

ex.en: When the market economy is introduced, many factories will not survive.
ex.zh: 一旦推行市场经济，很多工厂将无法存活下去。

ex.en: No one survived the crash.
ex.zh: 无人在这次撞击中幸免于难。

e.en: If you survive someone, you continue to live after they have died.

ex.en: Most women will survive their spouses.
ex.zh: 大多数女性比她们的配偶活得长。

d: v. （survive 的过去式和过去分词）幸存，活下来，幸免于难；从……中坚持过来，挺过，熬过；（事物）留存，保存下来，流传下来；比……活得长，比……长寿
n. 泰丝，苔丝，特丝（女子名，常作 Teresa、Tessa 等的昵称；亦指托马斯·哈代小说《德伯家的苔丝》中的女主人公）
abbr. 凌日系外行星巡天卫星（Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite，缩写为 TESS）

e.en: Someone who is troubled is worried because they have problems.

ex.en: Rose sounded deeply troubled.
ex.zh: 罗斯听上去极为烦恼。

e.en: A troubled place, situation, organization, or time has many problems or conflicts.

ex.en: There is so much we can do to help this troubled country.
ex.zh: 我们可做很多事来帮助这个骚乱的国家。

d: adj. 不安的，忧虑的，烦恼的；动乱的，混乱的，问题重重的；困惑的
v. trouble 的过去式和过去分词（使烦恼，使不安，打扰）

e.en: Urban means belonging to, or relating to, a city or town.

ex.en: For a small state it has a large urban population.
ex.zh: 作为一个小州，其城市人口算是很多了。

ex.en: Most urban areas are close to a park.
ex.zh: 大多数城区都靠近公园。

d: adj. 城市的，城镇的；黑人音乐的；住在都市的
【名】 （Urban）（英）厄本，（法）于尔邦（人名）

e.en: Something that is warm has some heat but not enough to be hot.

ex.en: Wheat is grown in places which have cold winters and warm, dry summers.
ex.zh: 小麦生长在冬季寒冷、夏季温暖干燥的地方。

ex.en: Because it was warm, David wore only a white cotton shirt.
ex.zh: 因为天气暖和，戴维只穿了一件白色棉衫。

e.en: Warm clothes and blankets are made of a material such as wool that protects you from the cold.

ex.en: They have been forced to sleep in the open without food or warm clothing.
ex.zh: 他们被迫睡在露天里，没有食物也没有保暖的衣服。

e.en: 保暖地

ex.en: Remember to wrap up warmly on cold days.
ex.zh: 记得天冷时穿暖和些。

e.en: Warm colours have red or yellow in them rather than blue or green, and make you feel comfortable and relaxed. 暖色调的;

ex.en: The basement hallway is painted a warm yellow.
ex.zh: 地下室的走廊被涂成暖色调的黄色。

d: adj. 暖和的，温暖的；（衣服或建筑物）保暖的，防寒的；友好的，热情的；暖色调的；（尤指儿童游戏中）快要发现的，即将猜中的；（土壤）吸热快的，保温的；（猎）（气味，踪迹）新鲜的，强烈的；（声音）充满情感的，浑厚饱满的
v. （使）温暖，（使）变暖和；（对某人） 产生好感，（对想法） 开始感兴趣；同情；激动；使……兴奋；  （使）变得更友好，变得更可爱；打（某人屁股）
n. 暖和的地方（或地区）（the warm）；取暖；厚呢短大衣（British warm的简称）
adv. 温暖地

e.en: very superior old: used to indicate that a brandy, port, etc, is between 12 and 17 years old 特佳陈酿(用来指窖藏达12-17年的白兰地、波尔图葡萄酒等)

d: abbr. 特级白兰地（Very Superior Old）；海外志愿服务队（Voluntary Service Overseas）

e.en: A village consists of a group of houses, together with other buildings such as a church and a school, in a country area.

ex.en: He lives quietly in the country in a village near Lahti.
ex.zh: 他在乡下拉赫蒂附近的一个村庄里过着平静的生活。

d: n. 乡村，村庄；在乡村的，乡村的；村民；（城市中带有村庄特点的）生活小区，居民区；（有有限自治权的）小自治市；高级城郊购物中心；（动物的）群落

e.en: Wit is the ability to use words or ideas in an amusing, clever, and imaginative way. 风趣;

ex.en: Boulding was known for his biting wit.
ex.zh: 博尔丁以其嘲讽式的风趣而出名。

e.en: If you say that someone has the wit to do something, you mean that they have the intelligence and understanding to make the right decision or take the right action in a particular situation.

ex.en: The information is there and waiting to be accessed by anyone with the wit to use it.
ex.zh: 信息是现成的，等着有头脑的人去获取和利用。

e.en: You can refer to your ability to think quickly and effectively in a difficult situation as your wits.

ex.en: She has used her wits to progress to the position she holds today.
ex.zh: 她用她的机智攀升到今天的这个位置。

e.en: You can use wits in expressions such as frighten someone out of their wits and scare the wits out of someone to emphasize that a person or thing worries or frightens someone very much.

ex.en: You scared us out of our wits. We heard you had an accident.
ex.zh: 你把我们吓坏了。我们听说你出事了。

d: n. （说话）风趣；说话风趣的人；机智；明智（the wit）；（不使用语言的）幽默机智
v. 知道；即，就是
【名】 （Wit）（泰）威，（英、德、波）威特（人名）

e.en: Young people, especially children, are sometimes referred to as youngsters. 年轻人 (尤指小孩)

ex.en: Other youngsters are not so lucky.
ex.zh: 其他的年轻人没有这么幸运。

d: n. 年轻人，尤指小孩（youngster 的复数）；幼小动物

e.en: A well-read person has read a lot of books and has learned a lot from them.

ex.en: He was clever, well-read and interested in the arts.
ex.zh: 他聪明，博览群书，并且对艺术感兴趣。

d: adj. 博览群书的，知识渊博的

e.en: You say well to indicate that you are about to say something. 哦 (用于将要说的话之前)

ex.en: Well, it's a pleasure to meet you.
ex.zh: 哦,很高兴见到你。

e.en: You say well just before or after you pause, especially to give yourself time to think about what you are going to say. (用于说话停顿的前后，尤用于给自己考虑的时间)

ex.en: Look, I'm really sorry I woke you, and, well, I just wanted to tell you I was all right.
ex.zh: 你看，我真抱歉吵醒了你，嗯，我只是想告诉你我一切都很好。

e.en: You say well when you are correcting something that you have just said. (用于更正刚说过的话)

ex.en: The comet is going to come back in 2061 and we are all going to be able to see it. Well, our offspring are, anyway.
ex.zh: 这颗彗星将于2061年返回，到时我们都可以看到它。哦，无论如何，我们子孙是可以看到的。

e.en: You say well to express your doubt about something that someone has said. (用于表示对别人说过的话的怀疑)

ex.en: "But finance is far more serious."—"Well I don't know really."
ex.zh: “但是财政形势更加严峻了。”—“啊，我真的不知道。”

d: n. 井（well 的复数）；源泉，来源（well 的复数）；（Wells）威尔斯，韦尔斯（英语姓氏，也指英国作家赫伯特·乔治·威尔斯）
v. 涌出，冒出（well 的第三人称单数，常与 up 连用）

e.en: A cycle is a series of events or processes that is repeated again and again, always in the same order.

ex.en: ...the life cycle of the plant.
ex.zh: …植物的生命周期。

e.en: A cycle is a single complete series of movements in an electrical, electronic, or mechanical process.

ex.en: ...10 cycles per second.
ex.zh: …每秒10圈。

e.en: A cycle is a bicycle.

ex.en: We supply the travel ticket for you and your cycle.
ex.zh: 我们为您和您的自行车提供旅行票。

e.en: If you cycle, you ride a bicycle.

ex.en: He cycled to Ingwold.
ex.zh: 他骑车去了英格沃尔德。

d: n. 骑自行车

e.en: literary knowledge, ability, or learning 文学; 知识;

ex.en: a man of letters

d: n. （letter 的复数）信，书信，函件；字母；（美国）缝制在运动服上的校运动队字母标志；文学；文学界；学识（常见于 man of letters、English letters、republic of letters 等搭配）；（非正式）（姓名后代表学位、职位或荣誉等资格的）首字母缩略词；法律文书（尤指正式证书或特许状，如 letters patent）；信用证，信用状（letters of credit）
v. （letter 的第三人称单数）把字母印刷（或缝制等）于；用字母标注；（非正式）（美国）因参加校运动队而被授予校名首字母标志
照片分享（一款运行在 iPhone 平台上的应用程序）

e.en: If something is useful, you can use it to do something or to help you in some way.

ex.en: The pressure cooker is very useful for people who go out all day.
ex.zh: 压力锅对整天外出的人非常有用。

ex.en: Hypnotherapy can be useful in helping you give up smoking.
ex.zh: 催眠疗法在帮助你戒烟方面可能有用。

e.en: 有用地

ex.en: ...the problems to which computers could be usefully applied.
ex.zh: …可以应用计算机来解决的问题。

e.en: If an object or skill comes in useful, it can help you achieve something in a particular situation.

ex.en: Extra blank paper will probably come in useful.
ex.zh: 额外的空白纸可能用得着。

d: adj. 有用的，有益的；好的，熟练的

e.en: If you provide something that someone needs or wants, or if you provide them with it, you give it to them or make it available to them.

ex.en: I'll be glad to provide a copy of this.
ex.zh: 我将很乐意提供这东西的一个副本。

ex.en: They would not provide any details.
ex.zh: 他们不肯提供任何细节。

e.en: If a law or agreement provides that something will happen, it states that it will happen.

ex.en: The treaty provides that, by the end of the century, the United States must have removed its bases.
ex.zh: 这项条约规定，到本世纪末，美国必须撤走其基地。

d: v. 提供，供给；配备，准备好；（法律或规章）规定（provide 的第三人称单数）；供养，赡养（用于 provide for）；为…作准备，防备（用于 provide against/for）

e.en: Activity is a situation in which a lot of things are happening or being done.

ex.en: Changes in the money supply affect the level of economic activity and the interest rate.
ex.zh: 货币供给的变化影响经济活动水平和利率。

ex.en: Children are supposed to get 60 minutes of physical activity every day.
ex.zh: 儿童应该每天获得60分钟的体育活动。

e.en: An activity is something that you spend time doing. (个体性的)

ex.en: For lovers of the great outdoors, activities range from canoeing to bird watching.
ex.zh: 对于户外活动的爱好者们来说，有从划船到观鸟的各种活动。

e.en: The activities of a group are the things that they do in order to achieve their aims. (群体性的)

ex.en: ...a jail term for terrorist activities.
ex.zh: …一个针对恐怖主义活动的刑期。

d: n. 活动（activity 的复数）；行动
n. 谢菲尔德（英国城市）

e.en: Drinks that can make people drunk, such as beer, wine, and whisky, can be referred to as alcohol.

ex.en: Do either of you smoke cigarettes or drink alcohol?
ex.zh: 你们两个人有人抽烟喝酒吗？

e.en: Alcohol is a colourless liquid that is found in drinks such as beer, wine, and whisky. It is also used in products such as perfumes and cleaning fluids.

ex.en: ...low-alcohol beer.
ex.zh: …低酒精度啤酒。

d: n. 含酒精饮品，酒；酒精，乙醇；醇

e.en: Booze is alcoholic drink.

ex.en: ...booze and cigarettes.
ex.zh: …酒和烟。

e.en: If people booze, they drink alcohol.

ex.en: ...a load of drunken businessmen who had been boozing all afternoon.
ex.zh: …一群整个下午都在喝酒、醉醺醺的商人。

d: n. （非正式）酒，酒精饮料；（Booze）人名（英译：布兹）
vi. （非正式）喝酒，豪饮，痛饮

e.en: If you attend a meeting or other event, you are present at it. 参加;

ex.en: Thousands of people attended the funeral.
ex.zh: 数千人参加了葬礼。

ex.en: The meeting will be attended by finance ministers from many countries.
ex.zh: 这次会议将有许多国家的财政部长出席。

e.en: If you attend an institution such as a school, college, or church, you go there regularly. 上 (学); 去 (教堂)

ex.en: They attended college together at the University of Pennsylvania.
ex.zh: 他们一起就读于宾夕法尼亚大学。

e.en: If you attend to something, you deal with it. If you attend to someone who is hurt or injured, you care for them. 处理;

ex.en: He took a short leave of absence to attend to personal business.
ex.zh: 他休了一个短假去处理私事。

d: adj. （医生）主治的
n. 主治医生
v. 出席，参加；随同，陪同；经常去，定期去（学校、教堂等）（attend 的现在分词）

e.en: An alcoholic is someone who cannot stop drinking large amounts of alcohol, even when this is making them ill.

ex.en: He showed great courage by admitting on television that he is an alcoholic.
ex.zh: 他在电视上承认他是个酒鬼，表现出了极大的勇气。

e.en: Alcoholic drinks are drinks that contain alcohol.

ex.en: The serving of alcoholic drinks was forbidden after six o'clock.
ex.zh: 在6点以后供应酒精饮料是被禁止的。

d: n. 酗酒者，嗜酒者（alcoholic 的复数）；Alcoholics Anonymous （匿名戒酒会，嗜酒者互诫协会）；（药学或化工用语，罕见）醇剂（alcoholic 的复数）

e.en: You can refer to the bricks in the walls of a building as the brickwork.

ex.en: There were cracks in the brickwork.
ex.zh: 砖墙上有些裂缝。

d: n. 砖砌体；砌砖，砌砖工作

e.en: A cycle is a series of events or processes that is repeated again and again, always in the same order.

ex.en: ...the life cycle of the plant.
ex.zh: …植物的生命周期。

e.en: A cycle is a single complete series of movements in an electrical, electronic, or mechanical process.

ex.en: ...10 cycles per second.
ex.zh: …每秒10圈。

e.en: A cycle is a bicycle.

ex.en: We supply the travel ticket for you and your cycle.
ex.zh: 我们为您和您的自行车提供旅行票。

e.en: If you cycle, you ride a bicycle.

ex.en: He cycled to Ingwold.
ex.zh: 他骑车去了英格沃尔德。

d: n. 自行车，摩托车；循环，周期；组诗，组歌；整套，系列；自行车骑行；一段时间
v. 骑自行车；循环

e.en: If you describe something as fascinating, you find it very interesting and attractive, and your thoughts tend to concentrate on it.

ex.en: Madagascar is the most fascinating place I have ever been to.
ex.zh: 马达加斯加是我去过的最迷人的地方。

d: adj. 极有吸引力的，迷人的
v. 深深吸引，迷住（fascinate 的现在分词形式）

e.en: Getting is the present participle of get. (get)

d: v. get 的现在分词：得到，获得；收到；买到；挣得；变得（后接形容词或比较级，表示逐渐变化）
n. 获得，获取；（Getting）（美、英、印）格廷（人名）

e.en: Human means relating to or concerning people. 人 (类)

ex.en: ...the human body.
ex.zh: …人体。

e.en: You can refer to people as humans, especially when you are comparing them with animals or machines. 人 (类)

ex.en: Like humans, cats and dogs are omnivores.
ex.zh: 和人类一样，猫和狗是杂食性动物。

e.en: Human feelings, weaknesses, or errors are ones that are typical of humans rather than machines. 人的 (感情、弱点); 人为的 (错误)

ex.en: ...an ever-growing risk of human error.
ex.zh: …一种日益增长的人为误差的风险。

d: n. 人类（human 的复数形式）

e.en: A cyclist is someone who rides a bicycle, or is riding a bicycle.

ex.en: ...better protection for pedestrians and cyclists.
ex.zh: …对行人和骑自行车的人的更好保护。

ex.en: And as the morning begins moving toward noon, look out for more cyclists and pedestrians.
ex.zh: 当早上快到中午的时候，要小心更多骑自行车的人和行人。

d: n. 骑自行车的人，骑自行车者（cyclist 的复数）

e.en: If something happens immediately, it happens without any delay.

ex.en: He immediately flung himself to the floor.
ex.zh: 他立即扑倒在地。

e.en: If something is immediately obvious, it can be seen or understood without any delay.

ex.en: The cause of the accident was not immediately apparent.
ex.zh: 这次事故的起因并非即刻可明。

e.en: Immediately is used to indicate that someone or something is closely and directly involved in a situation.

ex.en: The man immediately responsible for this misery is the province's governor.
ex.zh: 对这次惨剧负直接责任的人是该省省长。

e.en: Immediately is used to emphasize that something comes next, or is next to something else.

ex.en: They wish to begin immediately after dinner.
ex.zh: 他们希望晚饭后紧接着开始。

d: adv. 立即，马上；紧接地，紧靠地；直接地
conj. 一……就

e.en: You use for instance to introduce a particular event, situation, or person that is an example of what you are talking about.

ex.en: In sub-Saharan Africa today, for instance, gross investment accounts for roughly 15% of national income.
ex.zh: 例如，在如今的撒哈拉以南的非洲国家，总投资大约占国民收入的15％。

e.en: An instance is a particular example or occurrence of something.

ex.en: ...an investigation into a serious instance of corruption.
ex.zh: …对一例严重腐败事件的调查。

e.en: You say in the first instance to mention something that is the first step in a series of actions.

ex.en: In the first instance your child will be seen by an ear, nose and throat specialist.
ex.zh: 你的孩子首先要由耳鼻喉专家诊查。

d: n. 例子，实例
v. 举……为例
n. （非正式）女同性恋者
n. （Les）（美、加、澳）雷（人名）

e.en: a large area of grass which is specially designed for people to play golf on, especially one beside the sea
(as modifier) (在海边)
e.zh: 供人打高尔夫球的绿地的

ex.en: a links course

d: n. [计] 链接（link 的复数）；（海边长草沙地上的）高尔夫球场

e.en: If you write a letter to someone, you write a message on paper and send it to them, usually through the mail.

ex.en: I had received a letter from a very close friend.
ex.zh: 我收到了一位非常亲近的朋友的来信。

ex.en: ...a letter of resignation.
ex.zh: …一封辞职信。

e.en: Letters are written symbols which represent one of the sounds in a language.

ex.en: ...the letters of the alphabet.
ex.zh: …字母表中的字母。

e.en: If a student letters in sports or athletics by being part of the university or college team, they are entitled to wear on their jacket the initial letter of the name of their university or college. (因体育运动出色)

ex.en: Burkoth lettered in American football.
ex.zh: 伯考斯在足球赛中赢得了校名首字母徽章。

d: n. 信，信函；字母；（缝制在运动服上的）校运动队首字母标志；（代表学位或职位等资格的）首字母缩略词（letters）；文学；法律文书，正式文书（letters）；字面确切含义；（印刷）一种铅字字体； 学识，渊博的学问
v. 用字母标注；把字母印刷（或缝制等）于；赢得学校运动队的字母标志
【名】 （Letter）（美、英、巴西）莱特（人名）

e.en: If two substances mix or if you mix one substance with another, you stir or shake them together, or combine them in some other way, so that they become a single substance.

ex.en: Oil and water don't mix.
ex.zh: 油与水无法混合。

ex.en: A quick stir will mix them thoroughly.
ex.zh: 快速搅拌会使它们完全混合。

e.en: If you mix something, you prepare it by mixing other things together.

ex.en: He had spent several hours mixing cement.
ex.zh: 他用了几个小时的时间来搅拌水泥。

e.en: A mix is a powder containing all the substances that you need in order to make something such as a cake or a sauce. When you want to use it, you add liquid. (制作蛋糕或调味汁等的)

ex.en: For speed we used packets of pizza dough mix.
ex.zh: 为了赶速度，我们用了几包做比萨饼的混合面粉。

e.en: A mix of different things or people is two or more of them together.

ex.en: The story is a magical mix of fantasy and reality.
ex.zh: 这个故事是一个幻想与现实的奇妙组合。

d: v. （使）混合，（使）调和；使结合，组合；调制，配制；混合录音；（尤指与不相熟的人）交往，相处；不合，不相容；打起来，争吵起来
n. 混合体；（制作糕点、调味汁等的）混合原料，混合配料；（特定社会或团体内）各色人混杂的一群；（人群、混合物的）成分比例；混音，混录；乐曲组合，连奏；叠化图像，叠化声音
【名】 （Mix）（美、俄、巴）米克斯（人名）
n. （Kirkwood）人名；（英）柯克伍德
abbr. 全国护士理事会（national council of nurses）

e.en: If you say that someone is a nerd, you mean that they are unpopular or boring, especially because they wear unfashionable clothes or show too much interest in computers or science. 无聊的人; (对电脑或科技太过着迷的)

ex.en: Mark claimed he was made to look a nerd.
ex.zh: 马克称自己被搞得像个呆子一样。

ex.en: ...the notion that users of the Internet are all sad computer nerds.
ex.zh: ...对互联网玩家的看法是他们都是可怜的电脑痴。

d: n. 缺乏社交能力者，书呆子；技术迷，电脑迷

e.en: Your opinion about something is what you think or believe about it.

ex.en: I wasn't asking for your opinion, Mike.
ex.zh: 我不是在问你的看法，迈克。

ex.en: He held the opinion that a government should think before introducing a tax.
ex.zh: 他的看法是政府在推行一项税制前应先作考虑。

e.en: Your opinion of someone is your judgment of their character or ability.

ex.en: That improved Mrs. Goole's already favourable opinion of him.
ex.zh: 那更提高了古尔太太对他原有的好评。

e.en: You can refer to the beliefs or views that people have as opinion.

ex.en: Some, I suppose, might even be in positions to influence opinion.
ex.zh: 我认为，有些甚至可以影响舆论。

e.en: An opinion from an expert is the advice or judgment that they give you in the subject that they know a lot about. (专家的)

ex.en: Even if you have had a regular physical check-up recently, you should still seek a medical opinion.
ex.zh: 即使你最近已经进行了常规体检，也还是应该听听医学专家的意见。

d: n. 意见，看法；（群体的）观点，信仰；专家意见，专业意见；（对某人的）评价，印象；（法官或法院说明判决理由的）判决意见书
adv. 偶然，偶尔

e.en: You say please when you are politely asking or inviting someone to do something. 请 (用于礼貌地请求或邀请某人做某事)

ex.en: Can you help us please?
ex.zh: 能请你帮助我们吗？

ex.en: Please come in.
ex.zh: 请进。

e.en: You say please when you are accepting something politely. 有请 (用于礼貌地接受某物)

ex.en: "Tea?"—"Yes, please."
ex.zh: “要茶吗？—“好的，有请。”

e.en: You can say please to indicate that you want someone to stop doing something or stop speaking. You would say this if, for example, what they are doing or saying makes you angry or upset. 求你了 (请求别人停止做某事或停止讲话)

ex.en: Please, Mary, this is all so unnecessary.
ex.zh: 求你了，玛丽，这一切根本没有必要。

e.en: You can say please in order to attract someone's attention politely. 对不起 (用以引起某人注意)

ex.en: Please, Miss Smith, a moment.
ex.zh: 对不起，史密斯小姐，稍等。

d: int. 好吗，请（用于客气地请求）；请千万，请务必（用于加强请求的语气）；行，谢谢（用于接受别人的好意）；请别，请不要；得了吧；让我说
v. （使）开心，（使）满意；想，选择，喜欢；请便，随你的便

e.en: If you reclaim something that you have lost or that has been taken away from you, you succeed in getting it back. 拿回;

ex.en: In 1986, they got the right to reclaim South African citizenship.
ex.zh: 1986年，他们得到了恢复南非公民身份的权利。

e.en: If you reclaim an amount of money, for example tax that you have paid, you claim it back.

ex.en: The good news for the industry was that investors don't seem to be in any hurry to reclaim their money.
ex.zh: 对该行业来说，好消息是投资者们似乎不急于要求收回他们的钱。

e.en: When people reclaim land, they make it suitable for a purpose such as farming or building, for example by draining it or by building a barrier against the sea. 开垦;

ex.en: The Netherlands has been reclaiming farmland from water.
ex.zh: 荷兰一直在围海造田。

e.en: If a piece of land that was used for farming or building is reclaimed by a desert, forest, or the sea, it turns back into desert, forest, or sea. 重新变成 (沙漠、森林、海洋)

ex.en: The diamond towns are gradually being reclaimed by the desert.
ex.zh: 那些开采钻石的小镇逐渐被沙漠重新吞噬了。

d: v. reclaim 的现在分词／动名词形式；恢复，拿回，收回；要求归还，申请退还（税款等）；开垦，改造，围海造田；回收，再生（利用废料）

e.en: If you request something, you ask for it politely or formally. 请求;

ex.en: Mr. Dennis said he had requested access to a telephone.
ex.zh: 丹尼斯先生说他已正式要求要能够使用一部电话。

e.en: If you request someone to do something, you politely or formally ask them to do it.

ex.en: Students are requested to park at the rear of the building.
ex.zh: 学生们被要求在那座楼后面停车。

e.en: If you make a request, you politely or formally ask someone to do something.

ex.en: France had agreed to his request for political asylum.
ex.zh: 法国已经同意了他政治避难的请求。

e.en: If you do something at someone's request, you do it because they have asked you to.

ex.en: The evacuation is being organized at the request of the United Nations Secretary General.
ex.zh: 应联合国秘书长的要求，该撤离正在进行中。

d: n. 要求，请求；要求的事，点播的歌曲；（要求计算机提供信息或执行另一任务的）指令
v. 请求，要求；要求（某人）做……，请求（某人）做……；点播（乐曲）

e.en: When you return to a place, you go back there after you have been away.

ex.en: There are unconfirmed reports that Aziz will return to Moscow within hours.
ex.zh: 有未经证实的报道称阿齐兹将在数小时内返回莫斯科。

e.en: Your return is your arrival back at a place where you had been before.

ex.en: Kenny explained the reason for his sudden return to Dallas.
ex.zh: 肯尼解释了他突然返回达拉斯的理由。

e.en: If you return something that you have borrowed or taken, you give it back or put it back.

ex.en: I enjoyed the book and said so when I returned it.
ex.zh: 我很喜欢这本书，归还它的时候就这么说了。

e.en: Return is also a noun.

ex.en: The main demand of the Indians is for the return of one-and-a-half-million acres of forest to their communities.
ex.zh: 印第安人的主要要求是把150万英亩的森林归还给他们的族群。

d: v. 回来，回去；归还，退还；回报，回应；（感觉或情况）重新出现，恢复；重新开始，继续（某项活动）；带来，产生（利润或损失）；回击，击回； 宣告（裁决）；选举，选出；（建筑）（尤指成直角）转延（墙壁）；（高尔夫）打后九穴；（美橄）截获（对方传、踢或漏球）反攻；（桥牌）（尤指同伴所攻出的同花色牌赢墩后）跟着打出，回出；把（空瓶或空罐头盒）送到回收站
n. 回来，返回；归还，退回；重新开始，恢复；回报，收益； 往返票，来回票；返回键，回车键；（选举）结果；（网球等）回击球；（纳税）申报表，申报单；（建筑）转延，转延侧面；回路导线；被退回（或送回）的东西，退票；（可以回收的）空罐头盒，空瓶子（returns）
adj. （票）双程的，往返的；（旅途）返回的，返程的；（比赛）回访的；再度的，再次的

e.en: When you get rid of something that you do not want or do not like, you take action so that you no longer have it or suffer from it. 处理掉某物;

ex.en: The owner needs to get rid of the car for financial reasons.
ex.zh: 出于经济原因，车主需要处理掉这辆车。

e.en: If you get rid of someone who is causing problems for you or who you do not like, you do something to prevent them from affecting you anymore, for example by making them leave. 摆脱掉某人;

ex.en: He believed that his manager wanted to get rid of him for personal reasons.
ex.zh: 他认为他的经理出于个人原因想要撵走他。

e.en: If you rid a place or person of something undesirable or unwanted, you succeed in removing it completely from that place or person. 使 (某地、某人)

ex.en: The proposals are an attempt to rid the country of political corruption.
ex.zh: 这些提议是使该国摆脱政治腐败的一种尝试。
